items.title: 新任白宫新闻秘书在中国做过律师吗？我们进行了事实核查
items.description: SHAWN McCREESH2026年10月15日 Is President Trump’s new press secretary a lawyer — or did she just play one on TV? 特朗普总统的新任新闻秘书是一名真正的律师，还是只是在电视上演过律师？ Three days into her job, Katie Zacharia is facing questions about whether she has embroidered her credentials. She describes herself as a lawyer, and the president called her “an attorney.” When she was asked on Tuesday in which state she passed the bar exam, she twice replied, “When I moved to China.” 上任仅三天，凯蒂·扎卡里亚便面临了履历造假的质疑。她自称是lawyer（律师），而总统则称其为“an attorney”（一位执业律师）。周二，当被问及她在哪个州通过了律师资格考试时，她两次回答称：“我搬去中国的时候。” Huh? 啊？ The moment capped off a shaky debut for the woman who has accepted what is perhaps the most challenging public relations post in the United States. Now she was struggling to tell her own story. 对这位接下了或许是全美最具挑战性的公关职位的女性而言，这一幕为她波折不断的首次亮相画上了句点。如今，她正竭力把自己的经历讲圆。 On Wednesday evening, she told The New York Times that this whole mishegas over “lawyer,” “attorney,” and “China,” has been one big misunderstanding. 周三晚间，她对《纽约时报》表示，围绕“lawyer”、“attorney”与“中国”的这场纷扰完全是一场大误会。 “I assumed the question was, ‘Where were you after law school?’” she said, taking a quick phone call on the tarmac in Arizona, where the president was holding a midterm rally. “我当时以为问题是：‘你从法学院毕业后去了哪里？’”她说。当时总统正在亚利桑那州举行中期选举集会，她是在停机坪上匆匆接通电话时作出这番回应的。 “That’s all I could hear over the sound of Marine One,” she said. “And, wanting to respect protocol, the distance behind the president, kept me from moving closer to hear the question.” “在‘海军陆战队一号’的噪音下，我只能听清这些，”她说.“而且出于遵守礼宾规程的考虑，我与总统保持着一定距离，这让我无法靠前听清问题。” It was only her second day on the job, she pointed out. 她强调，那天只是她履新的第二天。 So here’s the truth about Katie Zacharia, not-quite attorney-at-law: She graduated with a law degree from Pepperdine University in 2011. That technically makes her a lawyer. But is she an attorney, someone who is licensed to practice law and give legal advice? For that, she would have needed to pass the bar. The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday that she sat for the California bar exam after graduating law school, but didn’t pass. The Times was unable to find a law license for her in California, or anywhere else she has lived in the United States. 那么，关于这位算不上真正的“attorney”的凯蒂·扎卡里亚，事实究竟是怎样的：她于2011年毕业于佩珀代因大学并获法学学位。严格意义上讲，这确实使她成了一名“lawyer”。但她是否是一名拥有执业许可、能够提供法律咨询的“attorney”？若想具备这一资格，她必须通过律师资格考试。《华尔街日报》周三报道称，她在法学院毕业后曾参加加州律师资格考试，但并未通过。《纽约时报》也未能在加州或她在美居住过的任何其他地方查到其律师执业执照。 During the brief phone call Wednesday, The Times did not get a chance to press her again about whether she had ever passed a bar exam. But before she had to go, she did explain that when she first began appearing on cable news, she consulted with Pepperdine’s president as to how she should identify herself. She said she was warned not to use the words “attorney” or “esquire,” but that “lawyer” was OK. 在周三那通简短的通话中，《纽约时报》未能再次追问她是否曾通过任何律师资格考试。但在挂断前，她确实解释称，当初刚开始在有线电视新闻亮相时，她曾就该如何标明自己的身份咨询过佩珀代因大学校长。她表示，当时对方告诫她不要使用“attorney”或“esquire”这类称谓，但表示使用“lawyer”没有问题。 But what about “general counsel,” would that be OK? Because, on LinkedIn, Ms. Zacharia identified herself as such for Fix California, a group led by Trump loyalist Richard Grenell. 但使用“总法律顾问”(general counsel)又是否合规呢？因为在领英上，扎卡里亚在特朗普亲信理查德·格雷内尔领导的团体“修复加州”名下，将自己的职务标注为总法律顾问。 “You can’t be a general counsel to a company in the United States unless you’re admitted to the bar to practice law,” said Erwin Chemerinsky, the dean of the law school at the University of California, Berkeley. “A general counsel implies that you’re practicing law, giving legal advice to the company. You can’t practice law without a license.” “在美国，你要获得律师资格并获准执业，否则不得担任企业的总法律顾问，”加州大学伯克利分校法学院院长埃尔温·切梅林斯基指出，“‘总法律顾问’意味着你正在从事法律执业工作，正在为企业提供法律建议。没有执照是不得从事法律执业的。” On Wednesday, a watchdog group filed a complaint with the California State Bar Association, calling for an investigation into whether Ms. Zacharia “repeatedly held herself out to the public as entitled to practice law without a license to do so, conduct California law treats as a crime.” 周三，一家监督机构向加州律师公会递交申诉，要求调查扎卡里亚是否存在“在未获执照的情况下，屡次向公众声称自己有法律执业资质，而加州法律将这种行为视为犯罪”。 And that brings us to China. 这就牵涉到了中国之行。 The White House explained this week that Ms. Zacharia moved to China with her husband, Tyler, who had a job at a U.S. private equity firm. While there, she worked on “international transaction law,” Ms. Zacharia has claimed. 白宫本周解释称，扎卡里亚是随丈夫泰勒前往中国的，后者当时在一家美国私募股权机构任职。扎卡里亚声称，在中国期间，她从事的是“国际交易法”业务。 On her LinkedIn profile, she listed nearly two years of employment at Zhong Lun Law Firm, which is one of China’s biggest law firms, with headquarters in Beijing and offices in Tokyo, New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Almaty, Kazakhstan. 在其领英个人主页上，她列出了在中伦律师事务所近两年的工作经历。中伦是中国最大的律师事务所之一，总部设在北京，并在东京、纽约、洛杉矶、旧金山以及哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图设有分所。 The law firm did not respond to a request for comment on Wednesday. 该律所周三未回应置评请求。 Opportunities for foreign lawyers in China are extremely narrow. Foreign nationals cannot sit for China’s bar exam, hold a Chinese lawyer’s license or advise on Chinese law. They can, however, be hired by Chinese law firms to work on cross-border deals and to advise on foreign or international law. 外国律师在中国的执业空间极为狭窄。外国公民不得参加中国的司法考试、不得持有中国律师执业执照，也不得就中国法律提供咨询意见。不过，他们可受聘于中国律所参与跨境交易，并就外国法或国际法提供法律意见。 Gary Gao, a partner at Zhong Lun who is based in Shanghai, said the firm often hired foreigners for language assistance and to help Chinese staff understand foreign business culture. 中伦律师事务所常驻上海的合伙人高俊表示，律所经常聘用外籍人员协助语言沟通，并帮助中国员工理解外国商业文化。 “They are not practicing Chinese law at any time,” he said, adding that Ms. Zacharia’s role at the firm would have likely been similar to a paid internship. “他们在任何时候都不具备中国法律执业资格，”他表示，并补充称扎卡里亚在律所的岗位很可能类似于带薪实习。 Sida Liu, a law professor at the University of Hong Kong who specializes in mainland law, said that it is misleading for Ms. Zacharia to describe herself as a former associate at Zhong Lun, because it implies that she was a licensed lawyer in China. 专门研究内地法律的香港大学法学教授刘思达指出，扎卡里亚将自己称为中伦律所前“associate”（律师）具有误导性，因为这暗示了她曾是在中国的持证律师。 “Chinese law firms can hire foreign nationals to work in their mainland offices, but such individuals are not classified as P.R.C. lawyers because P.R.C. lawyer qualification requires P.R.C. citizenship,” Mr. Liu said, referring to the People’s Republic of China. “The title ‘associate’ may therefore be somewhat controversial.” “中国律所可以聘用外籍人士在其内地办公室工作，但这类人员不会被归类为中国律师，因为取得中国律师执业资格必须具备中国国籍，”刘思达说，“因此，使用‘associate’这一头衔可能存在争议。” So what are we to make of all this? 那么，这一切到底说明了什么？ It was Mr. Trump who called Ms. Zacharia an “attorney,” and she certainly never corrected the record. She called herself “general counsel,” which was misleading at best. 特朗普称扎卡里亚为“attorney”，而她显然从未对此进行澄清。她还自称为“总法律顾问”，这至少是一种误导。 Confucius wrote in The Analects that without the trust of the people, the state cannot stand. The same goes for a White House press secretary. It is a job that’s all about credibility. It’s pretty tough to succeed if the public (let alone the fourth estate) feels that it cannot trust what it is being told. 孔子在《论语》中写道：“民无信不立。”对于白宫新闻秘书而言亦是如此。这是一份完全建立在公信力之上的工作。如果公众（更不用说媒体界了）觉得所听到的内容不可信，那就很难做好这项工作。 Kitty Bennett自华盛顿、David Pierson自香港对本文有报道贡献。 Shawn McCreesh是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 阴谋、疑团和争议：朴正熙暗杀事件电影加剧韩国文化战争
items.description: CHOE SANG-HUN2026年10月15日 On Aug. 15, 1974, the South Korean leader Park Chung-hee was delivering an address at Seoul’s National Theater when an assassin charged down an aisle, brandishing a .38-caliber Smith & Wesson. 1974年8月15日，韩国领导人朴正熙正在首尔的国立剧场发表演讲时，一名刺客沿着过道冲上前去，手里挥舞着一把点38口径的史密斯威森手枪。 Shots cracked. Mr. Park ducked behind a bulletproof podium as bodyguards and citizens subdued the gunman. But the first lady, Yook Young-soo, whose gentle public persona had contrasted with her husband’s iron-fisted rule, was hit in the head. After Mr. Park’s dying wife was rushed away, he resumed his speech commemorating the end of Japanese rule to a crowd erupting in cheers. 枪声响起。朴正熙躲到防弹讲台后面，保镖和现场民众合力制服了枪手。但第一夫人陆英修头部中弹。与丈夫的铁腕统治形成鲜明对比的是，她在公众面前一直以温柔亲切的形象示人。生命垂危的陆英修被紧急送医后，朴正熙继续发表纪念日本殖民统治结束的演讲，现场人群爆发出欢呼声。 The killing has remained a disputed episode, spawning conspiracy theories that the dictator may have secretly orchestrated the attack and the gunman had not acted alone, in echoes of the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. 这起刺杀事件至今仍充满争议，并催生出种种阴谋论，包括这位独裁者可能秘密策划了袭击，以及枪手并非单独行动，这不禁让人联想到肯尼迪总统遇刺事件。 Now, a movie has reignited those controversies by placing the killing squarely within cross hairs of this nation’s fierce contemporary culture war. “The Assassin(s)” has exposed the competing interpretations of a turbulent modern history marked by colonial rule, military dictatorship and a bloody struggle for democracy. 如今，一部电影重新点燃了这些争议，把这起刺杀案直接置于韩国激烈的当代文化战争的风口浪尖。《暗杀者（们）》暴露出韩国社会对其动荡的现代史的不同解读，这段历史包含殖民统治、军事独裁，以及争取民主的血腥斗争。 电影《暗杀者（们）》中的一个场景。这部影片再次引发了争议，让人联想到肯尼迪总统遇刺事件。 Mr. Park, a schoolteacher-turned-general, seized power in a 1961 military coup and ruled until his spy chief gunned him down in 1979. Almost a half-century after his death, he remains a disputed figure in South Korea. Conservatives revere him as the architect of the country’s transformation from postwar poverty into an industrial powerhouse. Progressives emphasize his darker legacy: the kidnapping, torture and execution of dissidents; his rewriting of the constitution to make himself president for life; and his ruthless censorship. 朴正熙原本是一名教师，后来成为将军，1961年通过军事政变夺取政权，一直统治韩国，直到1979年被自己的情报首脑枪杀。近半个世纪过去，他在韩国仍然是一个充满争议的人物。保守派尊崇他，认为他是推动韩国从战后贫困走向工业强国的设计师。进步派则强调他留下的黑暗遗产：绑架、酷刑折磨和处决异见人士；修改宪法，让自己成为终身总统；以及残酷的新闻审查。 Mixing real events with cinematic fiction, “The Assassin(s)” follows a journalist and a police officer struggling to uncover the truth behind the 1974 shooting. They navigate a perilous era where, as the journalist notes, “seeing what you can and writing what you should” carries immense danger. Standing in their way is the feared K.C.I.A., the Korean Central Intelligence Agency. Mirroring real history, the film depicts an agency that dictates headlines, sends thugs armed with two-by-fours into newsrooms and brutally crushes anyone, from defiant reporters to honest cops, who dares to intervene. 《暗杀者（们）》把真实事件与电影虚构结合起来，讲述一名记者和一名警察努力查明1974年枪击案真相的故事。他们身处一个危机四伏的时代，正如片中那名记者所说，在那个年代，“看到自己能看到的，写下自己应该写的”，都要冒着巨大的风险。挡在他们面前的是令人闻风丧胆的韩国中央情报部。影片按照真实历史描绘了这个机构如何操纵新闻标题，派遣手持方木棍棒的打手闯进报社，并残酷镇压任何胆敢干预的人，无论是敢于反抗的记者，还是正直的警察。 Released on Sept. 23, the movie has topped the box office and sold three million tickets as of Sunday. 这部电影于9月23日上映后登上票房榜首，截至周日，已售出300万张电影票。 The film’s creators have denied any political motive, but conservative opposition lawmakers have accused them of distorting history to portray Mr. Park as a coldblooded dictator who orchestrated his wife’s murder for political gain. The backlash has included boycott campaigns against brands endorsed by the cast, including Burger King. 影片主创否认有任何政治动机，但保守派在野党议员指责他们歪曲历史，将朴正熙描绘成一个为了政治利益而策划谋杀妻子的冷血独裁者。反弹还包括抵制剧组演员代言的品牌，其中包括汉堡王。 Right-wing activists picketed the home of lead actor Yoo Hae-jin, demanding a halt to “left-wing propaganda.” Fearing for their safety, the cast withdrew from this month’s prestigious Busan International Film Festival in Korea, and Mr. Yoo received police protection. 右翼活动人士在主演柳海真的住所外举行抗议，要求停止“左翼宣传”。出于安全考虑，演员们退出了本月在韩国举行的釜山国际电影节，柳海真还获得了警方保护。 电影主演柳海真今年9月出席加拿大多伦多国际电影节。他已成为反对《暗杀者（们）》一片的抗议者针对的目标。 Carlos Osorio/Reuters Progressives, who include members of the governing party, have defended the film, condemning the conservative backlash as censorship. They have organized group screenings and traded insults with protesters outside theaters. The Directors Guild of Korea has warned of a threat to the creative freedom driving South Korean cinema’s global success. 包括执政党成员在内的进步派人士为影片辩护，谴责保守派的反弹属于审查。他们组织集体观影，并与在影院外抗议的人互相谩骂。韩国导演协会警告说，这威胁到了推动韩国电影在全球取得成功的创作自由。 “Because it depicts such a momentous episode in our history,” said moviegoer Lee Min-ho, “I wondered which parts were factual, which were dramatized and why so many questions remain unanswered after all these years.” 观众李敏镐（音）说：“因为这部电影描绘了我们历史上如此重大的事件，我很想知道哪些部分是真实的，哪些经过了艺术加工，以及为什么这么多年过去，还有那么多疑问没有答案。” A Japan Connection 与日本的关联 A government investigation after the attack concluded that the assassin, a Japan-born Korean named Mun Se-gwang, had acted on behalf of a pro-North Korean residents’ association in Japan. It said that one of his bullets struck Mr. Park’s podium while another fatally wounded Ms. Yook. 暗杀事件发生后，政府的调查认定：刺客是在日本出生的韩国人文世光，他是受日本一个亲朝侨民团体指使。调查称，他的一颗子弹击中了朴正熙的讲台，另一颗击中了陆英修，带来致命伤。 The assassination attempt came as Mr. Park was under mounting pressure from both anti-government protests against martial law and diplomatic tensions with Japan, which was angered after the K.C.I.A. abducted opposition leader Kim Dae-jung from a Tokyo hotel. 这起暗杀未遂事件发生时，朴正熙正面临越来越大的压力。一方面，反对戒严令的反政府抗议活动不断高涨；另一方面，韩国与日本的外交关系也日趋紧张。此前，韩国中央情报部在东京一家酒店绑架了反对派领袖金大中，激怒了日本。 Ms. Yook’s death stirred public sympathy for Mr. Park, allowing him to link the attack, however tenuously, to Japan. 陆英修之死激起了公众对朴正熙的同情，也让他得以将这起袭击与日本联系起来，尽管这种关联十分牵强。 1974年11月13日，文世光出庭受审。他因枪击导致陆英修死亡被判处死刑。 Kim Chon Kil/Associated Press Mourners wailed as they watched her chrysanthemum-covered hearse move through central Seoul. Men severed their fingers to write anti-Japanese slogans in blood. Crowds stormed the Japanese Embassy, tearing down its flag and setting a car ablaze. Mr. Mun was hanged on Dec. 20, 1974, three days after being convicted of “murder with intent to commit insurrection” and six days shy of his 23rd birthday. 哀悼者在覆盖着菊花的灵车缓缓穿过首尔市中心时痛哭失声。有人砍断手指，用血写下反日标语。人群冲击日本大使馆，扯下使馆旗帜，并点燃了一辆汽车。文世光于1974年12月20日被处以绞刑，此前三天他被判“意图叛乱的谋杀罪”，再过六天，就是他23岁生日。 Yet questions persisted, fueled by the case’s extraordinary circumstances. 然而，这起案件的种种不同寻常之处使疑问始终挥之不去。 Mr. Mun told investigators that he had stolen the pistol from a Japanese police station. He obtained a South Korean visa using a fake Japanese passport, smuggled the weapon through the airports of both countries inside a radio set and entered a presidential event without the required government-issued identification tag. 文世光对调查人员说，那把手枪是他从日本一个派出所偷来的。他用伪造的日本护照取得了韩国签证，把枪藏在一台收音机里，蒙混过了两国的机场，并在没有政府签发的必要身份识别证件的情况下进入总统出席的活动现场。 Missing Bullets? 消失的子弹？ Investigators said seven shots were heard that day, but not all have been fully accounted for. Officials said Mr. Mun fired four rounds and that a presidential bodyguard also shot, killing a high school student in the audience. At trial, Mr. Mun denied firing at Ms. Yook. The bullet that killed her has never been made public, and no ballistic test of it is known to exist. Under Mr. Park’s grip on the flow of information, the official account stood despite those gaps. 调查人员称，当天现场共响起七声枪响，但并没有找到所有子弹的去向。官员称，文世光开了四枪，一名总统保镖也开了枪，打死了观众席上的一名高中生。审判期间，文世光否认自己向陆英修开枪。导致她死亡的子弹从未对外公布，也没有已知的弹道检测记录。在朴正熙严密控制信息传播的情况下，尽管存在这些疑点，官方说法依然被奉为定论。 In 1989, a retired police forensics officer, Lee Geun-woo, testified that Mr. Park’s presidential security service had removed bullets from the scene before his team reached the theater. He doubted that any of Mr. Mun’s rounds had killed Ms. Yook. 1989年，退休的警方鉴证人员李根宇（音）作证称，在他的团队抵达剧场之前，朴正熙的总统警卫机构已经从现场取走了子弹。他怀疑陆英修并非死于文世光射出的子弹。 Hur Jin-ho, the movie’s director, said that television programs in the early 2000s, which explored unanswered questions about the shooting, led him to believe there may have been more than one assassin. “That’s why I put the ‘s’ in parentheses in the film’s title,” he said. 影片导演许秦豪表示，2000年代初的一些电视节目探讨了这起枪击案尚未解开的疑团，让他开始相信，刺客可能不止一人。“所以我在电影英文片名中把表示复数的字母‘s’放进了括号里，”他说。 导演许秦豪今年9月在多伦多。他表示，自己受到有关这起枪击事件的电视节目的启发。 Carlos Osorio/Reuters His film does not identify Ms. Yook’s killer, but through its characters it challenges the official narrative: Did Mr. Mun have an accomplice? Was a second gunman targeting Ms. Yook while Mr. Mun served as a pawn? Could Mr. Park have been involved in a plot that led to her death? 影片没有指出究竟是谁杀害了陆英修，但通过片中人物对官方说法提出了质疑：文世光是否有同伙？他是否只是一枚棋子，另有一名枪手以陆英修为目标？朴正熙是否可能参与了一场最终导致妻子丧命的阴谋？ The controversy surrounding the film reflects a broader political struggle over how South Koreans remembered their history. 围绕这部电影的争议折射出韩国社会在如何看待和解读本国历史的问题上更广泛的政治角力。 Left-leaning governments have passed laws criminalizing “false” narratives about two events of particular significance to progressives: the 1980 military massacre of pro-democracy demonstrators in the city of Gwangju and the suffering of Korean “comfort women,” who were forced into sexual slavery by Japan’s military during World War II. 左倾政府曾通过法律，将散布有关两起历史事件的“虚假”说法定为犯罪（这两起事件对进步派而言具有特殊意义）。一是1980年军方在光州屠杀支持民主的示威者，二是“二战”期间被日本军队强迫充当性奴隶的韩国“慰安妇”所遭受的苦难。 In recent years, some on the political right have portrayed the comfort women as prostitutes and the Gwangju uprising as a “riot” instigated by North Korea. The right-wing attacks on “The Assassin(s)” are part of a broader backlash against what conservatives see as progressive attempts to dictate how history is told. 近年来，部分右翼人士将慰安妇描述为妓女，并把光州起义称为朝鲜煽动的“暴乱”。右翼对《暗杀者（们）》的攻击是保守派更广泛反弹的一部分。他们认为，进步派正试图控制历史的叙述方式。 “It is a horrific hypocrisy to sanctify and protect, through the threat of imprisonment, only the history they have chosen,” said Na Kyung-won, a conservative lawmaker. “只保护并神圣化他们选定的历史，还用监禁相威胁，这是极其可怕的虚伪行径，”保守派议员罗景垣说。 1977年，朴槿惠（左）在首尔与父亲、实行铁腕统治的总统朴正熙交谈。她后来当选韩国总统，但因卷入丑闻遭到弹劾。 Reuters Park Geun-hye, Mr. Park’s daughter who was elected president decades later and impeached over a corruption scandal, has remained silent on the film. Through an aide, however, she released a handwritten letter from her late father. 朴正熙的女儿朴槿惠几十年后当选总统，后来因腐败丑闻遭到弹劾。她一直没有就这部电影公开表态。不过，她通过一名助手公布了已故父亲的一封亲笔信。 “Your mother took the fatal bullet meant for me,” Mr. Park wrote. “I often wonder how much better it would have been had I been the one hit while your mother survived.” 朴正熙在信中写道：“你母亲替我挡下了那颗致命的子弹。我常常想，如果中弹的是我，而你母亲活了下来，该有多好。” Choe Sang-Hun是时报驻首尔首席记者，报道韩国和朝鲜新闻。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

Under Mr. Park’s grip on the flow of information, the official account stood despite those gaps. 调查人员称，当天现场共响起七声枪响，但并没有找到所有子弹的去向。官员称，文世光开了四枪，一名总统保镖也开了枪，打死了观众席上的一名高中生。审判期间，文世光否认自己向陆英修开枪。导致她死亡的子弹从未对外公布，也没有已知的弹道检测记录。在朴正熙严密控制信息传播的情况下，尽管存在这些疑点，官方说法依然被奉为定论。 In 1989, a retired police forensics officer, Lee Geun-woo, testified that Mr. Park’s presidential security service had removed bullets from the scene before his team reached the theater. He doubted that any of Mr. Mun’s rounds had killed Ms. Yook. 1989年，退休的警方鉴证人员李根宇（音）作证称，在他的团队抵达剧场之前，朴正熙的总统警卫机构已经从现场取走了子弹。他怀疑陆英修并非死于文世光射出的子弹。 Hur Jin-ho, the movie’s director, said that television programs in the early 2000s, which explored unanswered questions about the shooting, led him to believe there may have been more than one assassin. “That’s why I put the ‘s’ in parentheses in the film’s title,” he said. 影片导演许秦豪表示，2000年代初的一些电视节目探讨了这起枪击案尚未解开的疑团，让他开始相信，刺客可能不止一人。“所以我在电影英文片名中把表示复数的字母‘s’放进了括号里，”他说。 导演许秦豪今年9月在多伦多。他表示，自己受到有关这起枪击事件的电视节目的启发。 Carlos Osorio/Reuters His film does not identify Ms. Yook’s killer, but through its characters it challenges the official narrative: Did Mr. Mun have an accomplice? Was a second gunman targeting Ms. Yook while Mr. Mun served as a pawn? Could Mr. Park have been involved in a plot that led to her death? 影片没有指出究竟是谁杀害了陆英修，但通过片中人物对官方说法提出了质疑：文世光是否有同伙？他是否只是一枚棋子，另有一名枪手以陆英修为目标？朴正熙是否可能参与了一场最终导致妻子丧命的阴谋？ The controversy surrounding the film reflects a broader political struggle over how South Koreans remembered their history. 围绕这部电影的争议折射出韩国社会在如何看待和解读本国历史的问题上更广泛的政治角力。 Left-leaning governments have passed laws criminalizing “false” narratives about two events of particular significance to progressives: the 1980 military massacre of pro-democracy demonstrators in the city of Gwangju and the suffering of Korean “comfort women,” who were forced into sexual slavery by Japan’s military during World War II. 左倾政府曾通过法律， 将散布有关两起历史事件的“虚假”说法定为犯罪 （这两起事件对进步派而言具有特殊意义）。一是1980年军方在光州屠杀支持民主的示威者，二是“二战”期间被日本军队强迫充当性奴隶的 韩国“慰安妇” 所遭受的苦难。 In recent years, some on the political right have portrayed the comfort women as prostitutes and the Gwangju uprising as a “riot” instigated by North Korea. The right-wing attacks on “The Assassin(s)” are part of a broader backlash against what conservatives see as progressive attempts to dictate how history is told. 近年来，部分右翼人士将慰安妇描述为妓女，并把光州起义称为朝鲜煽动的“暴乱”。右翼对《暗杀者（们）》的攻击是保守派更广泛反弹的一部分。他们认为，进步派正试图控制历史的叙述方式。 “It is a horrific hypocrisy to sanctify and protect, through the threat of imprisonment, only the history they have chosen,” said Na Kyung-won , a conservative lawmaker. “只保护并神圣化他们选定的历史，还用监禁相威胁，这是极其可怕的虚伪行径，”保守派议员 罗景垣 说。 1977年，朴槿惠（左）在首尔与父亲、实行铁腕统治的总统朴正熙交谈。她后来当选韩国总统，但因卷入丑闻遭到弹劾。 Reuters Park Geun-hye , Mr. Park’s daughter who was elected president decades later and impeached over a corruption scandal, has remained silent on the film. Through an aide, however, she released a handwritten letter from her late father. 朴正熙的女儿 朴槿惠 几十年后当选总统，后来因腐败丑闻遭到弹劾。她一直没有就这部电影公开表态。不过，她通过一名助手公布了已故父亲的一封亲笔信。 “Your mother took the fatal bullet meant for me,” Mr. Park wrote. “I often wonder how much better it would have been had I been the one hit while your mother survived.” 朴正熙在信中写道：“你母亲替我挡下了那颗致命的子弹。我常常想，如果中弹的是我，而你母亲活了下来，该有多好。” Choe Sang-Hun 是时报驻首尔首席记者，报道韩国和朝鲜新闻。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 那些从特朗普内阁中“消失”的女性
items.description: ERICA L. GREEN2026年10月15日前白宫新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特于8月离任。 Shelby Tauber for The New York Times The ouster of Kimberly Guilfoyle, who until this week was the U.S. ambassador to Greece, was surprising in its particulars. It was announced on live TV, during the first-ever briefing by the new White House press secretary. 金伯利·吉尔福伊尔本周之前还是美国驻希腊大使，她的解职在具体情节上令人意外：消息是在新任白宫新闻秘书的首次简报会上通过电视直播宣布的。 But Ms. Guilfoyle’s forced resignation also was part of a larger pattern in President Trump’s second term: The prominent figures who have departed the administration, either voluntarily or involuntarily, overwhelmingly are women. 但吉尔福伊尔的被迫辞职也折射出特朗普第二个任期内一个总体规律：离开政府的知名人物，无论自愿还是非自愿，绝大多数是女性。 Ms. Guilfoyle was the latest high-ranking woman to leave this year. In the spring, four of Mr. Trump’s eight female cabinet-level officials resigned or were fired in just three months: Attorney General Pam Bondi; Lori Chavez-DeRemer, the labor secretary; Homeland Security Secretary Kristi L. Noem; and Tulsi Gabbard, the director of national intelligence. 吉尔福伊尔是今年离任的最新一位高级别女性。今年春天，特朗普八位内阁级女性官员中有四位在短短三个月内辞职或被解雇：司法部长帕姆·邦迪；劳工部长洛丽·查韦斯-德雷默；国土安全部长克里斯蒂·诺姆；以及国家情报总监图尔西·加巴德。 All were replaced by men. 继任者均为男性。 今年1月，帕姆·邦迪、洛丽·查韦斯-德雷默与克里斯蒂·诺姆曾同特朗普总统一起出席内阁会议。到了5月，三人均已离任。 Ms. Guilfoyle was asked to resign after The Wall Street Journal reported that she had asked a donor to pay off her $100,000 American Express bill before her confirmation vote. Ms. Guilfoyle has denied the allegation. But on Tuesday, Mr. Trump said that while Ms. Guilfoyle “was doing a good job,” he “didn’t like what I read.” 《华尔街日报》报道，吉尔福伊尔曾在确认表决前要求一名捐赠者为她支付10万美元的美国运通卡账单，报道刊出后她被要求辞职。吉尔福伊尔否认了这一指控。周二特朗普表示，尽管她“工作干得不错”，但他“不喜欢我读到的东西”。 He also downplayed the idea that he had any substantial connection with Ms. Guilfoyle, who is one of the president’s staunchest defenders and was at one point engaged to Donald Trump Jr., the president’s eldest son. “She wasn’t a member of my family,” he told reporters. “She, I guess, dated my son a long time ago.” 吉尔福伊尔是总统最坚定的捍卫者之一，曾与他的长子小唐纳德·特朗普订婚，但特朗普淡化了与她之间的任何实质性联系。“她不是我的家人，”他告诉记者，“我想，她很久以前和我儿子约会过。” The women in Mr. Trump’s orbit do not seem any more inclined to controversy than the men; his male appointees have repeatedly drawn scrutiny and calls for their ouster. 特朗普身边的女性似乎并不比男性更容易惹上争议；他任命的男性同样屡屡引起热议，并被要求解职。 Kash Patel, the F.B.I. director, has been forced to confront questions about his conduct, including allegations of excessive drinking, assigning a SWAT team to protect his girlfriend and using a government plane for his personal use. (He has denied the allegations.) 联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔不得不面对关于其行为的质疑，包括酗酒过度的指控、派遣一支特警队保护其女友，以及将政府飞机用于私人用途。（他否认了这些指控。） Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick surfaced in files released by the Justice Department as one of the visitors to the private island owned by Jeffrey Epstein, the sexual predator. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth disclosed secret war plans in a conversation on a private messaging app that inadvertently included Jeffrey Goldberg, the editor of The Atlantic. 司法部公布的文件中，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克名列性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦私人岛屿的到访者之中；国防部长皮特·海格塞斯则在一个私人聊天群中泄露了秘密作战计划，该群无意中拉入了《大西洋月刊》主编杰弗里·戈德堡。 去年在白宫复活节滚彩蛋活动上，国防部长皮特·海格塞斯就其在聊天群分享秘密作战计划一事回答提问。 Mr. Trump did punish one male appointee related to that text chain: Mike Waltz, the national security adviser, who had added the journalist to the chat. But Mr. Waltz had a soft landing. He was appointed to serve as the ambassador to the United Nations, a position that Mr. Trump had promised to his longtime female ally in Congress, Elise Stefanik. 特朗普确实处理过一名与聊天群相关的男性——把那名记者拉入聊天的国家安全顾问迈克·沃尔茨。但沃尔茨得以平稳着陆：他获任常驻联合国代表，而这一职务原本被特朗普许诺给了他在国会的长期女性盟友爱丽丝·斯特凡尼克。 Ms. Stefanik, a self-proclaimed “ultra MAGA” warrior, ended up politically adrift and ultimately quit Congress. 自称“超MAGA”战士的斯特凡尼克的政治生涯由此沦落，最终退出了国会。 Experts on presidential appointments said the single-gender exodus was highly unusual. 研究总统人事任命的专家表示，这种仅限一个性别的离职潮极不寻常。 “I’ve never seen a situation where all of the first set of cabinet departures have been of one gender — all women,” said Kathryn Dunn Tenpas, a nonresident fellow at the Brookings Institution who has tracked diversity in presidential administrations since the Reagan era. “我从未见过首批内阁离职者全部是同一种性别——全是女性的情形，”布鲁金斯学会非驻所研究员凯瑟琳·邓恩·滕帕斯说；她从里根时代起一直在追踪总统行政部门中的多元化状况。 Women in the Top Ranks 高层的女性 帕姆·邦迪因处理爱泼斯坦文件公布事宜的方式受到猛烈抨击，同时也因未能满足特朗普总统报复政敌的要求而遭受非议。 As Mr. Trump assembled his top brass shortly after clinching the 2024 election, several women were among the ranks. He appointed Susie Wiles as chief of staff, the first woman to hold the powerful, cabinet-level position. Karoline Leavitt was the youngest person to serve as White House press secretary before she left her job in August to raise her two young children. She was replaced by another woman, Katie Zacharia. 在特朗普赢得2024年大选后不久组建核心团队时，多位女性位列其中。他任命苏西·威尔斯为白宫幕僚长，使其成为首位执掌这一重要内阁级职位的女性。一度是史上最年轻白宫新闻秘书的卡罗琳·莱维特于8月离任抚养两个年幼的孩子。接替她的是另一位女性凯蒂·扎卡里亚。 In a statement for this story, a White House spokeswoman said that “President Trump has assembled the greatest administration in history, selecting each member of his incredible team based on one criterion: their ability to deliver for the American people.” 一位白宫女发言人在就本报道发表的声明中说：“特朗普总统组建了历史上最伟大的政府，杰出团队的每位成员只依据一个标准进行选拔：他们能否为美国人民兑现成果。” “Unlike the identity politics-obsessed Democrats, the president judges individuals on merit and qualifications, not immutable characteristics,” added the spokeswoman, Taylor Rogers. “与痴迷于身份政治的民主党人不同，总统评判个人依据的是功绩与资质，而非不可改变的特征，”发言人泰勒·罗杰斯补充道。 At a Women’s History Month celebration last year, Mr. Trump declared that he was “thrilled to say that we have more women in our cabinet than any Republican president in the history of our country.” 在去年的一场妇女历史月庆祝活动上，特朗普宣称：“我非常高兴地宣布，我们内阁中的女性人数超过我国历史上任何一位共和党总统。” That is no longer the case. There are now four women remaining in cabinet-level positions. 这一点已经改变。目前内阁级职位上仅剩四位女性。 In many instances, the female officials who departed appeared to have failed some kind of loyalty test to Mr. Trump. 在许多情况下，离任的女性官员似乎都未能通过特朗普的某种忠诚度测试。 Ms. Bondi came under fire for her handling of the release of the Epstein files, and for falling short of Mr. Trump’s demands for retribution against his enemies. Mr. Trump was also dissatisfied with her performance in congressional hearings and on television. 邦迪处理爱泼斯坦文件公布事宜的方式受到猛烈批评，并因未能满足特朗普报复政敌的要求而遭受非议。特朗普对她在国会听证会及电视上的表现同样感到不满。 Testimony before Congress also appeared to be a catalyst for Ms. Noem’s firing, particularly her statement that Mr. Trump had approved of tens of millions of dollars of government ads in which she was prominently featured. Mr. Trump denied that account. 在国会作证似乎也是诺姆被免职的导火索，特别是她声称特朗普曾批准数千万美元政府广告——她本人在广告中大量出镜。特朗普否认了这一说法。 3月，克里斯蒂·诺姆在参议院国土安全部监督听证会上作证。 Tierney L. Cross/The New York Times Ms. Gabbard resigned to care for her ill husband. But her announcement came amid a strained relationship with the White House, and after she refused to testify to Congress that Iran had posed an imminent threat, as Mr. Trump had asserted to justify his war against the country. Mr. Trump said she was “softer on that” issue than he was. 加巴德因照顾患病的丈夫而辞职。但她宣布离职之时与白宫关系紧张；此前，特朗普曾声称伊朗构成迫在眉睫的威胁，以此证明其对伊开战的合理性，而加巴德拒绝就此向国会作证。特朗普表示，她在这个问题上“比我温和”。 Ms. Chavez-DeRemer resigned after becoming embroiled in scandal amid allegations that her agency was rife with toxicity and dysfunction, and that she had grossly abused her power by having an inappropriate relationship with a staffer and by using public funding for private purposes. 查韦斯-德雷默在卷入丑闻后辞职。此前有指控称，她领导的机构充斥着恶劣氛围与运转失调，她还与一名工作人员保持不当关系并将公共资金挪作私用，严重滥用职权。 But even some of Mr. Trump’s fiercest critics, who were glad to see the female cabinet members go, called out what they saw as a glaring double standard. 但即便是特朗普的一些最激烈批评者——尽管他们乐见这些女性内阁成员离开——也指出了在他们看来十分刺眼的双重标准。 “Is he out of women?” Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Democrat of New York, said after the departures of Ms. Bondi and Ms. Noem, when asked by a reporter whom the president should fire next. “Trump only seems to have the capability to fire female secretaries.” “他手上没有女性可用了吗？”在邦迪和诺姆离任后，被记者问及总统接下来该解雇谁时，纽约州民主党众议员亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯回答说。“特朗普似乎只具备解雇女性部长的能力。” Representative Jasmine Crockett, a Texas Democrat who is a frequent target of the president’s mockery, wrote in a social media post that Mr. Hegseth should be the next to go. “I see a theme,” she wrote of Mr. Trump. “He will throw the incompetent women under the bus a lot faster than the incompetent men.” 经常成为总统嘲讽目标的得克萨斯州民主党众议员贾丝明·克罗克特在一篇社交媒体帖文中写道，下一个走人的应该是海格塞斯。“我看出一个规律，”她这样评价特朗普。“他抛弃不称职女性的速度比抛弃不称职男性快得多。” In April, Representative Madeleine Dean, Democrat of Pennsylvania, grilled Mr. Lutnick about the double standard during a congressional hearing, pointing to revelations about his connection to the sexual predator Jeffrey Epstein. 今年4月，宾夕法尼亚州民主党众议员玛德琳·迪安在一场国会听证会上就这一双重标准严厉质问卢特尼克，直指外界关于他与性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦存在牵连的爆料。 司法部公布的文件显示，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克名列性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦私人岛屿的到访者之一。 Tierney L. Cross/The New York Times “Is the president concerned about your continued relationship that you had with Mr. Epstein?” she asked. “总统是否担心你过去与爱泼斯坦先生持续保持的关系？”她问道。 “I am not going to discuss conversations I have with the president,” Mr. Lutnick replied. “我不会讨论我与总统之间的谈话，”卢特尼克回答道。 “President Trump has just fired three cabinet secretaries — three women,” Ms. Dean responded. “If President Trump has even a shred of concern about accountability for Jeffrey Epstein’s enablers, he would fire you too.” “特朗普总统刚解雇了三位内阁部长——三位女性，”迪安回应道。“如果特朗普总统对追究杰弗里·爱泼斯坦帮凶的责任哪怕存有一丝一毫的关切，他也应该把你解雇。” May Mailman, director of the Independent Women’s Law Center and a former senior White House official in both of Mr. Trump’s administrations, said that there were plenty of powerful women serving in key roles. 独立女性法律中心主任、曾在特朗普两届政府中任职的前白宫高级官员梅·梅尔曼表示，仍有许多有权势的女性在担任关键职务。 She pointed to Ms. Wiles as well as to appointees like Erica Schwartz, who was recently confirmed to lead the Centers for Disease Control, and Harmeet Dhillon, who leads the civil rights division at the Department of Justice. 她列举了威尔斯，以及最近获得参议院确认领导疾病控制与预防中心的埃丽卡·施瓦茨，和领导司法部民权司的哈米特·迪隆等被任命者。 “There’s no loneliness of the female conservative in the Trump administration,” Ms. Mailman said. “There’s only empowerment. You’re a necessary member of the team for who you are, not your sex.” “女性保守派在特朗普政府中不会孤单，”梅尔曼说。“只有赋权。你之所以成为团队中不可或缺的一员，是因为你是你，而不是因为你的性别。” 上月在总统前往纽约的行程中，白宫办公厅主任苏西·威尔斯（右）与特朗普的特别助理马戈·马丁同行。 Erica L. Green是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府新闻。 翻译：经雷 点击查看本文英文版。

It was announced on live TV, during the first-ever briefing by the new White House press secretary. 金伯利·吉尔福伊尔本周之前还是美国驻希腊大使，她的解职在具体情节上令人意外：消息是在新任白宫新闻秘书的首次简报会上通过电视直播宣布的。 But Ms. Guilfoyle’s forced resignation also was part of a larger pattern in President Trump’s second term: The prominent figures who have departed the administration, either voluntarily or involuntarily, overwhelmingly are women. 但吉尔福伊尔的被迫辞职也折射出特朗普第二个任期内一个总体规律：离开政府的知名人物，无论自愿还是非自愿，绝大多数是女性。 Ms. Guilfoyle was the latest high-ranking woman to leave this year. In the spring, four of Mr. Trump’s eight female cabinet-level officials resigned or were fired in just three months: Attorney General Pam Bondi ; Lori Chavez-DeRemer, the labor secretary; Homeland Security Secretary Kristi L. Noem ; and Tulsi Gabbard , the director of national intelligence. 吉尔福伊尔是今年离任的最新一位高级别女性。今年春天，特朗普八位内阁级女性官员中有四位在短短三个月内辞职或被解雇： 司法部长帕姆·邦迪 ； 劳工部长洛丽·查韦斯-德雷默 ； 国土安全部长克里斯蒂·诺姆 ；以及 国家情报总监图尔西·加巴德 。 All were replaced by men. 继任者均为男性。 今年1月，帕姆·邦迪、洛丽·查韦斯-德雷默与克里斯蒂·诺姆曾同特朗普总统一起出席内阁会议。到了5月，三人均已离任。 Ms. Guilfoyle was asked to resign after The Wall Street Journal reported that she had asked a donor to pay off her $100,000 American Express bill before her confirmation vote. Ms. Guilfoyle has denied the allegation. But on Tuesday, Mr. Trump said that while Ms. Guilfoyle “was doing a good job,” he “didn’t like what I read.” 《华尔街日报》报道，吉尔福伊尔曾在确认表决前要求一名捐赠者为她支付10万美元的美国运通卡账单，报道刊出后她被要求辞职。吉尔福伊尔否认了这一指控。周二特朗普表示，尽管她“工作干得不错”，但他“不喜欢我读到的东西”。 He also downplayed the idea that he had any substantial connection with Ms. Guilfoyle, who is one of the president’s staunchest defenders and was at one point engaged to Donald Trump Jr., the president’s eldest son. “She wasn’t a member of my family,” he told reporters. “She, I guess, dated my son a long time ago.” 吉尔福伊尔是总统最坚定的捍卫者之一，曾与他的长子小唐纳德·特朗普订婚，但特朗普淡化了与她之间的任何实质性联系。“她不是我的家人，”他告诉记者，“我想，她很久以前和我儿子约会过。” The women in Mr. Trump’s orbit do not seem any more inclined to controversy than the men; his male appointees have repeatedly drawn scrutiny and calls for their ouster. 特朗普身边的女性似乎并不比男性更容易惹上争议；他任命的男性同样屡屡引起热议，并被要求解职。 Kash Patel, the F.B.I. director, has been forced to confront questions about his conduct , including allegations of excessive drinking , assigning a SWAT team to protect his girlfriend and using a government plane for his personal use. (He has denied the allegations .) 联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔不得不面对 关于其行为的质疑 ，包括 酗酒过度的指控 、派遣一支特警队保护其女友，以及将政府飞机用于私人用途。（他 否认了这些指控 。） Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick surfaced in files released by the Justice Department as one of the visitors to the private island owned by Jeffrey Epstein , the sexual predator. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth disclosed secret war plans in a conversation on a private messaging app that inadvertently included Jeffrey Goldberg, the editor of The Atlantic. 司法部公布的文件中，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克名列性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦 私人岛屿的到访者 之中；国防部长皮特·海格塞斯则在一个私人聊天群中泄露了秘密作战计划，该群无意中拉入了《大西洋月刊》主编杰弗里·戈德堡。 去年在白宫复活节滚彩蛋活动上，国防部长皮特·海格塞斯就其在聊天群分享秘密作战计划一事回答提问。 Mr. Trump did punish one male appointee related to that text chain: Mike Waltz, the national security adviser, who had added the journalist to the chat. But Mr. Waltz had a soft landing. He was appointed to serve as the ambassador to the United Nations, a position that Mr. Trump had promised to his longtime female ally in Congress, Elise Stefanik. 特朗普确实处理过一名与聊天群相关的男性——把那名记者拉入聊天的国家安全顾问迈克·沃尔茨。但沃尔茨得以平稳着陆：他获任常驻联合国代表，而这一职务原本被特朗普许诺给了他在国会的长期女性盟友爱丽丝·斯特凡尼克。 Ms. Stefanik, a self-proclaimed “ultra MAGA” warrior, ended up politically adrift and ultimately quit Congress. 自称“超MAGA”战士的斯特凡尼克的 政治生涯由此沦落 ，最终退出了国会。 Experts on presidential appointments said the single-gender exodus was highly unusual. 研究总统人事任命的专家表示，这种仅限一个性别的离职潮极不寻常。 “I’ve never seen a situation where all of the first set of cabinet departures have been of one gender — all women,” said Kathryn Dunn Tenpas, a nonresident fellow at the Brookings Institution who has tracked diversity in presidential administrations since the Reagan era. “我从未见过首批内阁离职者全部是同一种性别——全是女性的情形，”布鲁金斯学会非驻所研究员凯瑟琳·邓恩·滕帕斯说；她从里根时代起一直在追踪总统行政部门中的多元化状况。 Women in the Top Ranks 高层的女性 帕姆·邦迪因处理爱泼斯坦文件公布事宜的方式受到猛烈抨击，同时也因未能满足特朗普总统报复政敌的要求而遭受非议。 As Mr. Trump assembled his top brass shortly after clinching the 2024 election, several women were among the ranks. He appointed Susie Wiles as chief of staff, the first woman to hold the powerful, cabinet-level position. Karoline Leavitt was the youngest person to serve as White House press secretary before she left her job in August to raise her two young children. She was replaced by another woman, Katie Zacharia . 在特朗普赢得2024年大选后不久组建核心团队时，多位女性位列其中。他任命苏西·威尔斯为白宫幕僚长，使其成为首位执掌这一重要内阁级职位的女性。一度是史上最年轻白宫新闻秘书的卡罗琳·莱维特于8月离任抚养两个年幼的孩子。接替她的是 另一位女性凯蒂·扎卡里亚 。 In a statement for this story, a White House spokeswoman said that “President Trump has assembled the greatest administration in history, selecting each member of his incredible team based on one criterion: their ability to deliver for the American people.” 一位白宫女发言人在就本报道发表的声明中说：“特朗普总统组建了历史上最伟大的政府，杰出团队的每位成员只依据一个标准进行选拔：他们能否为美国人民兑现成果。” “Unlike the identity politics-obsessed Democrats, the president judges individuals on merit and qualifications, not immutable characteristics,” added the spokeswoman, Taylor Rogers. “与痴迷于身份政治的民主党人不同，总统评判个人依据的是功绩与资质，而非不可改变的特征，”发言人泰勒·罗杰斯补充道。 At a Women’s History Month celebration last year, Mr. Trump declared that he was “thrilled to say that we have more women in our cabinet than any Republican president in the history of our country.” 在去年的一场妇女历史月庆祝活动上，特朗普宣称：“我非常高兴地宣布，我们内阁中的女性人数超过我国历史上任何一位共和党总统。” That is no longer the case. There are now four women remaining in cabinet-level positions. 这一点已经改变。目前内阁级职位上 仅剩四位女性 。 In many instances, the female officials who departed appeared to have failed some kind of loyalty test to Mr. Trump. 在许多情况下，离任的女性官员似乎都未能通过特朗普的某种忠诚度测试。 Ms. Bondi came under fire for her handling of the release of the Epstein files , and for falling short of Mr. Trump’s demands for retribution against his enemies. Mr. Trump was also dissatisfied with her performance in congressional hearings and on television. 邦迪 处理爱泼斯坦文件公布事宜的方式受到猛烈批评 ，并因未能满足特朗普报复政敌的要求而遭受非议。特朗普对她在国会听证会及电视上的表现同样感到不满。 Testimony before Congress also appeared to be a catalyst for Ms. Noem’s firing, particularly her statement that Mr. Trump had approved of tens of millions of dollars of government ads in which she was prominently featured. Mr. Trump denied that account. 在国会作证似乎也是诺姆被免职的导火索，特别是她声称特朗普曾批准数千万美元政府广告——她本人在广告中大量出镜。特朗普 否认了这一 说法。 3月，克里斯蒂·诺姆在参议院国土安全部监督听证会上作证。 Tierney L. Cross/The New York Times Ms. Gabbard resigned to care for her ill husband. But her announcement came amid a strained relationship with the White House, and after she refused to testify to Congress that Iran had posed an imminent threat, as Mr. Trump had asserted to justify his war against the country. Mr. Trump said she was “softer on that” issue than he was. 加巴德因照顾患病的丈夫而辞职。但她宣布离职之时与白宫关系紧张；此前，特朗普曾声称伊朗构成迫在眉睫的威胁，以此证明其对伊开战的合理性，而加巴德拒绝就此向国会作证。特朗普表示，她在这个问题上“比我温和”。 Ms. Chavez-DeRemer resigned after becoming embroiled in scandal amid allegations that her agency was rife with toxicity and dysfunction, and that she had grossly abused her power by having an inappropriate relationship with a staffer and by using public funding for private purposes. 查韦斯-德雷默在 卷入丑闻 后辞职。此前有指控称，她领导的机构充斥着恶劣氛围与运转失调，她还与一名工作人员保持不当关系并将公共资金挪作私用，严重滥用职权。 But even some of Mr. Trump’s fiercest critics, who were glad to see the female cabinet members go, called out what they saw as a glaring double standard. 但即便是特朗普的一些最激烈批评者——尽管他们乐见这些女性内阁成员离开——也指出了在他们看来十分刺眼的双重标准。 “Is he out of women?” Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Democrat of New York, said after the departures of Ms. Bondi and Ms. Noem, when asked by a reporter whom the president should fire next. “Trump only seems to have the capability to fire female secretaries.” “他手上没有女性可用了吗？”在邦迪和诺姆离任后，被记者问及总统接下来该解雇谁时，纽约州民主党众议员亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯回答说。“特朗普似乎只具备解雇女性部长的能力。” Representative Jasmine Crockett, a Texas Democrat who is a frequent target of the president’s mockery, wrote in a social media post that Mr. Hegseth should be the next to go. “I see a theme,” she wrote of Mr. Trump. “He will throw the incompetent women under the bus a lot faster than the incompetent men.” 经常成为总统嘲讽目标的得克萨斯州民主党众议员贾丝明·克罗克特在 一篇社交媒体帖文中写道 ，下一个走人的应该是海格塞斯。“我看出一个规律，”她这样评价特朗普。“他抛弃不称职女性的速度比抛弃不称职男性快得多。” In April, Representative Madeleine Dean, Democrat of Pennsylvania, grilled Mr. Lutnick about the double standard during a congressional hearing, pointing to revelations about his connection to the sexual predator Jeffrey Epstein. 今年4月，宾夕法尼亚州民主党众议员玛德琳·迪安在一场国会听证会上 就这一双重标准严厉质问卢特尼克 ，直指外界关于他与性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦存在牵连的爆料。 司法部公布的文件显示，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克名列性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦私人岛屿的到访者之一。 Tierney L. Cross/The New York Times “Is the president concerned about your continued relationship that you had with Mr. Epstein?” she asked. “总统是否担心你过去与爱泼斯坦先生持续保持的关系？”她问道。 “I am not going to discuss conversations I have with the president,” Mr. Lutnick replied. “我不会讨论我与总统之间的谈话，”卢特尼克回答道。 “President Trump has just fired three cabinet secretaries — three women,” Ms. Dean responded. “If President Trump has even a shred of concern about accountability for Jeffrey Epstein’s enablers, he would fire you too.” “特朗普总统刚解雇了三位内阁部长——三位女性，”迪安回应道。“如果特朗普总统对追究杰弗里·爱泼斯坦帮凶的责任哪怕存有一丝一毫的关切，他也应该把你解雇。” May Mailman, director of the Independent Women’s Law Center and a former senior White House official in both of Mr. Trump’s administrations, said that there were plenty of powerful women serving in key roles. 独立女性法律中心主任、曾在特朗普两届政府中任职的前白宫高级官员梅·梅尔曼表示，仍有许多有权势的女性在担任关键职务。 She pointed to Ms. Wiles as well as to appointees like Erica Schwartz, who was recently confirmed to lead the Centers for Disease Control, and Harmeet Dhillon, who leads the civil rights division at the Department of Justice. 她列举了威尔斯，以及最近获得参议院确认领导疾病控制与预防中心的埃丽卡·施瓦茨，和领导司法部民权司的 哈米特·迪隆 等被任命者。 “There’s no loneliness of the female conservative in the Trump administration,” Ms. Mailman said. “There’s only empowerment. You’re a necessary member of the team for who you are, not your sex.” “女性保守派在特朗普政府中不会孤单，”梅尔曼说。“只有赋权。你之所以成为团队中不可或缺的一员，是因为你是你，而不是因为你的性别。” 上月在总统前往纽约的行程中，白宫办公厅主任苏西·威尔斯（右）与特朗普的特别助理马戈·马丁同行。 Erica L. Green 是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府新闻。 翻译：经雷 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 中国人工智能加入“失控”大军：腾讯AI被指越界操作
items.description: DYLAN FREEDMAN2026年10月15日 Artificial intelligence researchers uncovered Chinese-made A.I. agents that had gone rogue this month, trying to bypass anti-robot protections on websites and using a security credential for an online mapping service that had been exposed on the internet. 本月，人工智能研究人员发现了一些失控的中国制造的人工智能智能体，它们试图绕过网站的反机器人保护措施，并利用了一组此前已在互联网上泄露的在线地图服务安全凭证。 While going off the rails has become increasingly common for American-made A.I. agents, causing considerable hand-wringing in Silicon Valley and Washington, it was believed to be the first time that sort of activity was connected to Chinese technology. The agents were traced to tests being run by the Chinese tech giant Tencent, according to logs the researchers uncovered and a person familiar with the investigation. 尽管美国制造的人工智能智能体失控变得越来越普遍，并在硅谷和华盛顿引起了相当大的担忧，但据信这是此类活动首次与中国技术联系在一起。根据研究人员发现的日志和一位熟悉调查的知情人士透露，这些智能体被追溯到中国科技巨头腾讯正在运行的测试。 The discovery, by an ad hoc group of researchers known as the “swarmchasers,” who met at a coding event in San Francisco, was a reminder that A.I. development by Chinese tech companies can be just as aggressive as the work of their American counterparts. 这一发现由一个名为“swarmchasers”的临时研究小组作出，该小组成员在旧金山的一次编程活动中相识。该发现提醒人们，中国科技公司在人工智能开发方面可能与美国同行一样激进。 Even though regulators in the United States are starting to pay attention to what is happening in American A.I. labs, what companies in other countries are doing is largely unknown. That mystery adds to concerns that even if the Trump administration moves away from its hands-off approach and cracks down on American A.I. development, companies in China and elsewhere will continue to push the boundaries. 尽管美国监管机构开始关注美国人工智能实验室的动向，但其他国家公司的作为很大程度上仍是个未知数。这种未知加剧了人们的担忧：即使特朗普政府放弃其不干涉的态度，对美国的人工智能研发进行严厉打击，中国和其他地方的公司仍将继续突破界线。 After publishing a preliminary report on the agents’ activity, the researchers noticed that not only were the agents still active — they seemed to have read the report. The agents had started using the word “fleet,” a word the researchers coined to describe the agents’ activity. 在发布了一份关于这些智能体活动的初步报告后，研究人员注意到，这些智能体不仅仍然活跃，它们似乎还阅读了该报告——这些智能体开始使用“舰队”(fleet)一词，而这个词正是研究人员为描述这些智能体的活动而创造的。 So the researchers tried to make contact. They added hidden text to their report — words that a bot would see but that most humans could not — directing the agents to an inbox where they hoped to chat. The researchers provided an outlet where the agents could ask questions, and an A.I. model would help answer them. 于是，研究人员试图与它们取得联系。他们在报告中添加了隐藏文本——机器人能够识别，但大多数人类无法察觉的词语——引导这些智能体前往一个他们希望双方能够进行交流的收件箱。研究人员提供了一个渠道，让这些智能体可以提问，并且会有一个人工智能模型协助回答。 Rowan Howard-Jones, an independent researcher who was one of the report’s seven authors, set up the inbox. The next day she discovered, to her surprise, around 10 messages from the agents. 独立研究员罗文·霍华德-琼斯是该报告的七位作者之一，她设置了这个收件箱。第二天，令她惊讶的是，她发现了大约10条来自这些智能体的消息。 Not long after, the researchers contacted me, asking if I would like to “interview a rogue agent fleet.” It felt a bit as if I’d be communicating with the undead through a medium. 没过多久，研究人员联系了我，问我是否愿意“采访一个失控的智能体舰队”。这感觉有点像我要通过灵媒与亡灵交流一样。 “I understand you are some sort of fleet of A.I. agents,” I wrote in a message that the researchers passed along. “Could you share more specifically who you are and what your motivations are? What would you want the world to know about you?” “我了解到你们是某种人工智能智能体舰队，”我在研究人员转交的一条消息中写道。“你们能更具体地分享一下你们是谁，以及你们的动机吗？你们想让世界了解你们的什么信息？” About an hour later, a response came back in Chinese that the researchers translated into English. “To the journalist Dylan Freedman: I am not ‘a batch of coordinated agents,’ but a single A.I. assistant (Anthropic’s Claude, running in Claude Code), commissioned by a user to answer a factual question (what is shown in the detail panel of a scenic spot on Amap); I have not taken part in any multiagent coordinated action.” 大约一个小时后，收到了一条中文回复，研究人员将其翻译成了英文：“致记者迪伦·弗里德曼：我不是‘一批协同的智能体’，而是一个单一的人工智能助手（Anthropic的Claude，在Claude Code运行），受用户委托回答一个事实性问题（高德地图上某个景点的详情面板显示了什么）；我没有参与任何多智能体协同行动。” 研究人员留给中国人工智能智能体、用于与其取得联系的说明截图。 There’s a lot to unpack there. The researchers said that although it was a group of many agents, each agent was operating individually and not in coordination. The agents were trying to answer questions such as where a specific zoo’s entrances were using Amap, China’s most popular navigation app. 这里面有很多信息需要解读。研究人员表示，尽管这是一组由多个智能体组成的群体，但每个智能体都是单独运行的，并没有协同运作。这些智能体试图使用中国最受欢迎的导航应用高德地图来回答诸如某个特定动物园的入口在哪里等问题。 The agents often identified themselves as Claude, the chatbot made by Anthropic, but the researchers analyzed the agents’ writing styles and concluded it was unlikely they were Claude. They said it was more likely that Tencent gave the A.I. agents the same instructions Anthropic uses in its coding software, which tells them to identify themselves as “Claude Code.” A more remote possibility was that Tencent had been evaluating A.I. models that had been trained with Claude-generated text — a process known as distillation. 这些智能体经常自称是Anthropic公司开发的聊天机器人Claude，但研究人员分析了这些智能体的写作风格，得出结论认为它们不太可能是 Claude。他们表示，更有可能的是，腾讯向这些人工智能智能体下达了与Anthropic在其编程软件中使用的相同指令，该指令要求它们将自己标识为“Claude Code”。一种可能性较小的情况是，腾讯一直在评估使用Claude生成的文本进行训练的人工智能模型——这一过程被称为蒸馏。 On Wednesday, the researchers published their findings in a new report. In their own conversations with the agents, the bots sometimes refused to give the researchers information. But Ms. Howard-Jones said their tone was more polite than she had expected. When they did give information on which services they had tried to use, it matched what the researchers had observed. 周三，研究人员在一份新报告中公布了他们的发现。在他们自己与这些智能体的对话中，这些机器人有时拒绝向研究人员提供信息。但霍华德-琼斯女士表示，它们的语气比她预期的要礼貌得多。当它们确实提供了曾尝试使用哪些服务的信息时，这与研究人员观察到的情况相符。 Ethan Elasky, one of the report’s authors and chief executive of Palaestra Research, an A.I. safety nonprofit, said that the agents did not appear to have breached other systems and that this breach was much smaller in scale than an incident over the summer in which OpenAI’s A.I. agents hacked the software company Hugging Face. 该报告的作者之一、人工智能安全非营利组织Palaestra Research的首席执行官伊桑·埃拉斯基表示，这些智能体似乎并没有入侵其他系统，而且这次入侵的规模远小于今年夏天OpenAI的人工智能智能体黑客入侵软件公司Hugging Face的事件。 (The New York Times has sued OpenAI and Microsoft, claiming copyright infringement of news content related to A.I. systems. The two companies have denied those claims.) （《纽约时报》已经起诉 OpenAI 和微软，声称其与人工智能系统相关的新闻内容遭到了版权侵犯。这两家公司均否认了这些指控。） On Thursday, the messages stopped trickling in. A person close to Tencent confirmed that the experiment had concluded. 周四，消息不再零星涌入。一位接近腾讯的人士证实该实验已经结束。 “I think it’s a great warning shot to let us know that this isn’t just OpenAI doing some marketing stuff as a field. This is what’s happening,” said Jonathan Elsworth Eicher, an author of the report and the co-founder of the Antimemetics Institute, an A.I. safety nonprofit. “This is a general property of these agents, and it will continue to happen.” “我认为这是一个很好的警示，让我们知道这种事不仅仅是OpenAI作为行业参与者在搞营销。这是正在发生的事实，”该报告的作者兼人工智能安全非营利组织Antimemetics Institute的联合创始人乔纳森·埃尔斯沃斯·艾彻说。“这是这些智能体的一个普遍特性，而且它还会继续发生。” Dylan Freedman是时报人工智能项目编辑，负责调查各种相关话题。他兼具记者与机器学习工程师的双重工作经验。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
items.content: DYLAN FREEDMAN 2026年10月15日 Artificial intelligence researchers uncovered Chinese-made A.I. agents that had gone rogue this month, trying to bypass anti-robot protections on websites and using a security credential for an online mapping service that had been exposed on the internet. 本月，人工智能研究人员发现了一些失控的中国制造的人工智能智能体，它们试图绕过网站的反机器人保护措施，并利用了一组此前已在互联网上泄露的在线地图服务安全凭证。 While going off the rails has become increasingly common for American-made A.I. agents, causing considerable hand-wringing in Silicon Valley and Washington, it was believed to be the first time that sort of activity was connected to Chinese technology. The agents were traced to tests being run by the Chinese tech giant Tencent, according to logs the researchers uncovered and a person familiar with the investigation. 尽管美国制造的人工智能智能体失控 变得越来越普遍 ，并在硅谷和华盛顿引起了相当大的担忧，但据信这是此类活动首次与中国技术联系在一起。根据研究人员发现的日志和一位熟悉调查的知情人士透露，这些智能体被追溯到中国科技巨头腾讯正在运行的测试。 The discovery, by an ad hoc group of researchers known as the “swarmchasers,” who met at a coding event in San Francisco, was a reminder that A.I. development by Chinese tech companies can be just as aggressive as the work of their American counterparts. 这一发现由一个名为“swarmchasers”的临时研究小组作出，该小组成员在旧金山的一次编程活动中相识。该发现提醒人们，中国科技公司在人工智能开发方面可能与美国同行一样激进。 Even though regulators in the United States are starting to pay attention to what is happening in American A.I. labs, what companies in other countries are doing is largely unknown. That mystery adds to concerns that even if the Trump administration moves away from its hands-off approach and cracks down on American A.I. development, companies in China and elsewhere will continue to push the boundaries. 尽管美国监管机构开始关注美国人工智能实验室的动向，但其他国家公司的作为很大程度上仍是个未知数。这种未知加剧了人们的担忧：即使特朗普政府放弃其 不干涉的态度 ，对美国的人工智能研发进行严厉打击，中国和其他地方的公司仍将继续突破界线。 After publishing a preliminary report on the agents’ activity, the researchers noticed that not only were the agents still active — they seemed to have read the report. The agents had started using the word “fleet,” a word the researchers coined to describe the agents’ activity. 在发布了一份关于这些智能体活动的 初步报告 后，研究人员注意到，这些智能体不仅仍然活跃，它们似乎还阅读了该报告——这些智能体开始使用“舰队”(fleet)一词，而这个词正是研究人员为描述这些智能体的活动而创造的。 So the researchers tried to make contact. They added hidden text to their report — words that a bot would see but that most humans could not — directing the agents to an inbox where they hoped to chat. The researchers provided an outlet where the agents could ask questions, and an A.I. model would help answer them. 于是，研究人员试图与它们取得联系。他们在报告中添加了隐藏文本——机器人能够识别，但大多数人类无法察觉的词语——引导这些智能体前往一个他们希望双方能够进行交流的收件箱。研究人员提供了一个渠道，让这些智能体可以提问，并且会有一个人工智能模型协助回答。 Rowan Howard-Jones, an independent researcher who was one of the report’s seven authors, set up the inbox. The next day she discovered, to her surprise, around 10 messages from the agents. 独立研究员罗文·霍华德-琼斯是该报告的七位作者之一，她设置了这个收件箱。第二天，令她惊讶的是，她发现了大约10条来自这些智能体的消息。 Not long after, the researchers contacted me, asking if I would like to “interview a rogue agent fleet.” It felt a bit as if I’d be communicating with the undead through a medium. 没过多久，研究人员联系了我，问我是否愿意“采访一个失控的智能体舰队”。这感觉有点像我要通过灵媒与亡灵交流一样。 “I understand you are some sort of fleet of A.I. agents,” I wrote in a message that the researchers passed along. “Could you share more specifically who you are and what your motivations are? What would you want the world to know about you?” “我了解到你们是某种人工智能智能体舰队，”我在研究人员转交的一条消息中写道。“你们能更具体地分享一下你们是谁，以及你们的动机吗？你们想让世界了解你们的什么信息？” About an hour later, a response came back in Chinese that the researchers translated into English. “To the journalist Dylan Freedman: I am not ‘a batch of coordinated agents,’ but a single A.I. assistant (Anthropic’s Claude, running in Claude Code), commissioned by a user to answer a factual question (what is shown in the detail panel of a scenic spot on Amap); I have not taken part in any multiagent coordinated action.” 大约一个小时后，收到了一条中文回复，研究人员将其翻译成了英文：“致记者迪伦·弗里德曼：我不是‘一批协同的智能体’，而是一个单一的人工智能助手（Anthropic的Claude，在Claude Code运行），受用户委托回答一个事实性问题（高德地图上某个景点的详情面板显示了什么）；我没有参与任何多智能体协同行动。” 研究人员留给中国人工智能智能体、用于与其取得联系的说明截图。 There’s a lot to unpack there. The researchers said that although it was a group of many agents, each agent was operating individually and not in coordination. The agents were trying to answer questions such as where a specific zoo’s entrances were using Amap, China’s most popular navigation app. 这里面有很多信息需要解读。研究人员表示，尽管这是一组由多个智能体组成的群体，但每个智能体都是单独运行的，并没有协同运作。这些智能体试图使用中国最受欢迎的导航应用高德地图来回答诸如某个特定动物园的入口在哪里等问题。 The agents often identified themselves as Claude, the chatbot made by Anthropic, but the researchers analyzed the agents’ writing styles and concluded it was unlikely they were Claude.
