In their own conversations with the agents, the bots sometimes refused to give the researchers information. But Ms. Howard-Jones said their tone was more polite than she had expected. When they did give information on which services they had tried to use, it matched what the researchers had observed. 周三，研究人员在一份 新报告 中公布了他们的发现。在他们自己与这些智能体的对话中，这些机器人有时拒绝向研究人员提供信息。但霍华德-琼斯女士表示，它们的语气比她预期的要礼貌得多。当它们确实提供了曾尝试使用哪些服务的信息时，这与研究人员观察到的情况相符。 Ethan Elasky, one of the report’s authors and chief executive of Palaestra Research, an A.I. safety nonprofit, said that the agents did not appear to have breached other systems and that this breach was much smaller in scale than an incident over the summer in which OpenAI’s A.I. agents hacked the software company Hugging Face. 该报告的作者之一、人工智能安全非营利组织Palaestra Research的首席执行官伊桑·埃拉斯基表示，这些智能体似乎并没有入侵其他系统，而且这次入侵的规模远小于今年夏天OpenAI的人工智能智能体黑客入侵软件公司Hugging Face的 事件 。 (The New York Times has sued OpenAI and Microsoft , claiming copyright infringement of news content related to A.I. systems. The two companies have denied those claims.) （《纽约时报》已经 起诉 OpenAI 和微软 ，声称其与人工智能系统相关的新闻内容遭到了版权侵犯。这两家公司均否认了这些指控。） On Thursday, the messages stopped trickling in. A person close to Tencent confirmed that the experiment had concluded. 周四，消息不再零星涌入。一位接近腾讯的人士证实该实验已经结束。 “I think it’s a great warning shot to let us know that this isn’t just OpenAI doing some marketing stuff as a field. This is what’s happening,” said Jonathan Elsworth Eicher, an author of the report and the co-founder of the Antimemetics Institute, an A.I. safety nonprofit. “This is a general property of these agents, and it will continue to happen.” “我认为这是一个很好的警示，让我们知道这种事不仅仅是OpenAI作为行业参与者在搞营销。这是正在发生的事实，”该报告的作者兼人工智能安全非营利组织Antimemetics Institute的联合创始人乔纳森·埃尔斯沃斯·艾彻说。“这是这些智能体的一个普遍特性，而且它还会继续发生。” Dylan Freedman 是时报人工智能项目编辑，负责调查各种相关话题。他兼具记者与机器学习工程师的双重工作经验。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 中国出口激增，年度贸易顺差有望再次刷新纪录
items.description: KEITH BRADSHER2026年10月15日货币疲软使中国商品在海外更具竞争力，同时提高了国内进口产品的成本。 Gilles Sabrié for The New York Times A record-setting surge in China’s exports dwarfed its imports in September, as the country’s vast manufacturing sector churned out cars, solar panels, electrical equipment and other goods for markets worldwide. 中国出口在9月的创纪录激增使其进口相形见绌，该国庞大的制造业部门为全球市场生产了汽车、太阳能电池板、电气设备和其他商品。 China’s General Administration of Customs said the country recorded a $133.5 billion trade surplus last month, the second-highest month ever. The latest figures put China on course to considerably exceed last year’s record $1.19 trillion trade surplus. 中国海关总署表示，中国上月录得1335亿美元的贸易顺差，为有史以来第二高的月份。最新数据使中国有望大幅超过去年创纪录的1.19万亿美元贸易顺差。 Another month of skyrocketing exports is expected to further stoke tensions with many trading partners, including in Europe, where anger over the flood of Chinese vehicles and other items is prompting some leaders to propose a so-called “kill switch” to shut out goods from China. 出口再次飙升预计将进一步加剧与许多贸易伙伴的紧张关系，包括欧洲。在那里，对中国汽车和其他商品大量涌入的愤怒正促使一些领导人提议所谓的“紧急切断开关”，以将中国商品拒之门外。 Economists disagree on how much of China’s enormous trade surplus is driven by stronger exports and how much stems from weaker imports. A weak currency has helped make Chinese goods more competitive overseas, while raising the cost of imported products at home. 对于中国巨大的贸易顺差有多少由出口走强驱动，又有多少源于进口疲软，经济学家们存在分歧。疲软的货币使中国商品在海外更具竞争力，同时提高了国内进口产品的成本。 The value of the renminbi, China’s currency, has fallen more than 14 percent in inflation-adjusted terms against a broad set of currencies since March 2022, according to the Bank of International Settlements, an institution owned by the world’s central banks, including China’s. March 2022 was when China began a two-month Covid-19 lockdown in Shanghai, which dealt a lasting blow to consumer confidence. 据国际清算银行称，自2022年3月以来，人民币经通胀调整后的价值相对于广泛的一篮子货币下跌了超过14%。国际清算银行由世界各国央行共同拥有，包括中国央行。2022年3月，中国开始在上海实施为期两个月的新冠疫情封锁，对消费者信心造成了持久打击。 Broad tax breaks for exporters have also fueled the export boom. The incentives cost China’s finance ministry about $318 billion last year. 对出口商的广泛税收减免也推动了出口繁荣。这些激励措施去年使中国财政部花费了约3180亿美元。 The customs agency said exports soared 36.3 percent in September from a year earlier. It was the largest year-on-year percentage gain in Chinese exports since July 2010, excluding months distorted by the timing of Lunar New Year. 海关机构表示，9月出口同比增长36.3%。这是自2010年7月以来中国出口最大的同比百分比增幅，不包括因农历新年时间而数据偏差的月份。 Exports climbed to a record $447.2 billion. September’s trade surplus trailed only January 2025, when the timing of Lunar New Year prompted Chinese exporters to rush orders before the extended holiday. 出口攀升至创纪录的4472亿美元。9月的贸易顺差仅次于2025年1月，当时农历新年的时间促使中国出口商在长假前赶订单。 Despite the export surge, Beijing has been reluctant to cut tax breaks for exporters or to allow the currency to appreciate sharply, fearing job losses in industries already squeezed by tariffs. In Guangzhou, a garment manufacturing hub, producers are struggling to compete with lower-wage countries. 尽管出口激增，但由于担心已在关税压力下的行业出现失业，北京仍不愿削减对出口商的税收减免或允许人民币大幅升值。在广州这个服装制造中心，生产商正艰难地与低工资国家竞争。 On a recent afternoon, a factory making padded jackets was nearly deserted because it lacked orders. “If you’re producing for export, there are tariffs to deal with, and fabric and labor are expensive, so a lot of people don’t want to do exports anymore,” said the factory’s manager, who gave his family name, Ling. 在最近的一个下午，一家生产棉服外套的工厂几乎空无一人，因为没有订单。“如果你为出口生产，就要应对关税，而且面料和劳动力都很贵，所以很多人不想再做出口了，”该工厂的经理说。他只提供了自己的姓氏“凌”（音）。 At the same time, a prolonged housing market crash and rising unemployment have left many Chinese households reluctant to spend. Beijing has also poured government support into building domestic manufacturing industries, reducing the country’s reliance on imported goods. 与此同时，旷日持久的房地产市场崩溃和不断上升的失业率使许多中国家庭不愿消费。北京还向国内制造业提供了大量支持，减少了中国对进口商品的依赖。 Chinese companies are also pinched by rising raw material costs and weak consumer demand that leaves little room to raise prices. Factory-gate and mining prices rose 5 percent in September from a year earlier, the National Bureau of Statistics reported on Wednesday, while consumer prices increased just 0.9 percent. 中国企业还受到原材料成本上升和消费者需求疲软的双重挤压，后者导致几乎没有提价空间。国家统计局周三报告称，9月出厂价格和采矿价格同比上涨5%，而消费者价格仅上涨0.9%。 Sluggish consumer demand and expanding domestic production have depressed imports of almost everything except raw materials such as oil and copper, much of which are used to manufacture further exports. Imports rose 31 percent in September from the same month a year earlier, partly because imported oil costs rose substantially. 低迷的消费者需求和不断扩大的国内生产压低了除石油和铜等原材料以外几乎所有商品的进口，这些原材料大部分用于制造进一步的出口产品。9月进口同比增长31%，部分原因是进口石油成本大幅上涨。 China’s auto industry offers a particularly stark picture of the divide between weak domestic demand and booming exports. Retail car sales plunged 28 percent in September from a year earlier, according to the China Passenger Car Association, which works closely with the country’s car dealers 中国汽车行业提供了一个尤其鲜明的画面，展示了疲软的国内需求与蓬勃发展的出口之间的鸿沟。据与中国汽车经销商密切合作的中国乘用车协会称，9月零售汽车销量同比暴跌28%。 From the summer of 2024 through the end of 2025, China offered generous subsidies to encourage consumers to trade in older gas guzzlers for electric cars and plug-in, gasoline-electric hybrid cars. The program brought forward purchases that might otherwise have taken place this year, contributing to the current sales slump. 从2024年夏季到2025年底，中国提供了慷慨的补贴，鼓励消费者以旧换新，将旧的高油耗汽车换成纯电和插电式汽油-电动混合动力汽车。该计划提前了本可能今年发生的购买，导致了当前的销售暴跌。 But the broader economic slowdown now appears to be taking a greater toll than the expiration of those incentives. The number of cars sold at dealerships in September was also down nearly 20 percent below the level in September 2023, before the trade-in program began. 但更广泛的经济放缓眼下所造成的影响似乎比这些激励措施的到期更大。9月经销商售出的汽车数量相比2023年9月——以旧换新计划开始之前——的水平也低了近20%。 While domestic sales have faltered, China’s car exports have soared, and are up 11-fold since 2020. The flood of Chinese-made vehicles into overseas markets has alarmed automakers elsewhere, particularly in Europe. 虽然国内销售已经动摇，中国的汽车出口却飙升，自2020年以来增长了11倍。中国制造的汽车大量涌入海外市场，令其他地方的汽车制造商感到震惊，尤其是在欧洲。 On Friday, the European Union and China said they had reached an “understanding” to limit China’s exports of plug-in hybrid cars to Europe. China’s trade surplus set another record with Europe last month. 周五，欧盟和中国表示他们已达成“谅解”，以限制中国向欧洲出口插电式混合动力汽车。中国上个月与欧洲的贸易顺差再创纪录。 China’s manufacturing exports have surged since it joined the World Trade Organization in 2001, when Beijing pledged to open financial services, including credit cards, to foreign competition. After 25 years of delays, during which China built its own electronic payments system, Visa announced Tuesday that Beijing took a step toward letting it establish a bank card clearing business, though further approvals are needed. 自2001年中国加入世界贸易组织以来，中国的制造业出口大幅增长，当时北京承诺向外国竞争开放金融服务，包括信用卡。在25年的拖延之后——中国利用这段时间建立了自己的电子支付系统，Visa周二宣布北京已采取措施允许其建立银行卡清算业务，但仍需进一步批准。 After decades of American complaints about delays, the Visa decision, along with the compromise with Europe on plug-in hybrid cars, suggests Beijing may be taking small steps to address foreign concerns about its trade surplus. 数十年来美国一直就这一拖延表达不满，Visa的决定以及就插电式混合动力汽车与欧洲达成的妥协表明，北京可能正在采取小步骤来解决外国对其贸易顺差的关切。 Ruoxin Zhang对本文有研究贡献。 Keith Bradsher是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
items.content: KEITH BRADSHER 2026年10月15日 货币疲软使中国商品在海外更具竞争力，同时提高了国内进口产品的成本。 Gilles Sabrié for The New York Times A record-setting surge in China’s exports dwarfed its imports in September, as the country’s vast manufacturing sector churned out cars, solar panels, electrical equipment and other goods for markets worldwide. 中国出口在9月的创纪录激增使其进口相形见绌，该国庞大的制造业部门为全球市场生产了汽车、太阳能电池板、电气设备和其他商品。 China’s General Administration of Customs said the country recorded a $133.5 billion trade surplus last month, the second-highest month ever. The latest figures put China on course to considerably exceed last year’s record $1.19 trillion trade surplus . 中国海关总署表示，中国上月录得1335亿美元的贸易顺差，为有史以来第二高的月份。最新数据使中国有望大幅超过去年 创纪录的1.19万亿美元贸易顺差 。 Another month of skyrocketing exports is expected to further stoke tensions with many trading partners, including in Europe, where anger over the flood of Chinese vehicles and other items is prompting some leaders to propose a so-called “kill switch” to shut out goods from China. 出口再次飙升预计将进一步加剧与许多贸易伙伴的紧张关系，包括欧洲。在那里，对中国汽车和其他商品大量涌入的愤怒正促使一些领导人提议所谓的“紧急切断开关”，以将中国商品拒之门外。 Economists disagree on how much of China’s enormous trade surplus is driven by stronger exports and how much stems from weaker imports. A weak currency has helped make Chinese goods more competitive overseas, while raising the cost of imported products at home. 对于中国巨大的贸易顺差有多少由出口走强驱动，又有多少源于进口疲软，经济学家们存在分歧。疲软的货币使中国商品在海外更具竞争力，同时提高了国内进口产品的成本。 The value of the renminbi, China’s currency, has fallen more than 14 percent in inflation-adjusted terms against a broad set of currencies since March 2022, according to the Bank of International Settlements, an institution owned by the world’s central banks, including China’s. March 2022 was when China began a two-month Covid-19 lockdown in Shanghai, which dealt a lasting blow to consumer confidence. 据国际清算银行称，自2022年3月以来，人民币经通胀调整后的价值相对于广泛的一篮子货币下跌了超过14%。国际清算银行由世界各国央行共同拥有，包括中国央行。2022年3月，中国开始在上海实施为期两个月的新冠疫情封锁，对消费者信心造成了持久打击。 Broad tax breaks for exporters have also fueled the export boom. The incentives cost China’s finance ministry about $318 billion last year. 对出口商的广泛税收减免 也推动了出口繁荣。这些激励措施去年使中国财政部花费了约3180亿美元。 The customs agency said exports soared 36.3 percent in September from a year earlier. It was the largest year-on-year percentage gain in Chinese exports since July 2010, excluding months distorted by the timing of Lunar New Year. 海关机构表示，9月出口同比增长36.3%。这是自2010年7月以来中国出口最大的同比百分比增幅，不包括因农历新年时间而数据偏差的月份。 Exports climbed to a record $447.2 billion. September’s trade surplus trailed only January 2025, when the timing of Lunar New Year prompted Chinese exporters to rush orders before the extended holiday. 出口攀升至创纪录的4472亿美元。9月的贸易顺差仅次于2025年1月，当时农历新年的时间促使中国出口商在长假前赶订单。 Despite the export surge, Beijing has been reluctant to cut tax breaks for exporters or to allow the currency to appreciate sharply, fearing job losses in industries already squeezed by tariffs. In Guangzhou, a garment manufacturing hub, producers are struggling to compete with lower-wage countries. 尽管出口激增，但由于担心已在关税压力下的行业出现失业，北京仍不愿削减对出口商的税收减免或允许人民币大幅升值。在广州这个服装制造中心，生产商正艰难地与低工资国家竞争。 On a recent afternoon, a factory making padded jackets was nearly deserted because it lacked orders. “If you’re producing for export, there are tariffs to deal with, and fabric and labor are expensive, so a lot of people don’t want to do exports anymore,” said the factory’s manager, who gave his family name, Ling. 在最近的一个下午，一家生产棉服外套的工厂几乎空无一人，因为没有订单。“如果你为出口生产，就要应对关税，而且面料和劳动力都很贵，所以很多人不想再做出口了，”该工厂的经理说。他只提供了自己的姓氏“凌”（音）。 At the same time, a prolonged housing market crash and rising unemployment have left many Chinese households reluctant to spend. Beijing has also poured government support into building domestic manufacturing industries, reducing the country’s reliance on imported goods. 与此同时，旷日持久的房地产市场崩溃和不断上升的失业率使许多中国家庭不愿消费。北京还向国内制造业提供了大量支持，减少了中国对进口商品的依赖。 Chinese companies are also pinched by rising raw material costs and weak consumer demand that leaves little room to raise prices. Factory-gate and mining prices rose 5 percent in September from a year earlier, the National Bureau of Statistics reported on Wednesday, while consumer prices increased just 0.9 percent. 中国企业还受到原材料成本上升和消费者需求疲软的双重挤压，后者导致几乎没有提价空间。国家统计局周三报告称，9月出厂价格和采矿价格同比上涨5%，而消费者价格仅上涨0.9%。 Sluggish consumer demand and expanding domestic production have depressed imports of almost everything except raw materials such as oil and copper, much of which are used to manufacture further exports. Imports rose 31 percent in September from the same month a year earlier, partly because imported oil costs rose substantially. 低迷的消费者需求和不断扩大的国内生产压低了除石油和铜等原材料以外几乎所有商品的进口，这些原材料大部分用于制造进一步的出口产品。9月进口同比增长31%，部分原因是进口石油成本大幅上涨。 China’s auto industry offers a particularly stark picture of the divide between weak domestic demand and booming exports. Retail car sales plunged 28 percent in September from a year earlier, according to the China Passenger Car Association, which works closely with the country’s car dealers 中国汽车行业提供了一个尤其鲜明的画面，展示了疲软的国内需求与蓬勃发展的出口之间的鸿沟。据与中国汽车经销商密切合作的中国乘用车协会称，9月零售汽车销量同比暴跌28%。 From the summer of 2024 through the end of 2025, China offered generous subsidies to encourage consumers to trade in older gas guzzlers for electric cars and plug-in, gasoline-electric hybrid cars. The program brought forward purchases that might otherwise have taken place this year, contributing to the current sales slump. 从2024年夏季到2025年底，中国提供了慷慨的补贴，鼓励消费者 以旧换新 ，将旧的高油耗汽车换成纯电和插电式汽油-电动混合动力汽车。该计划提前了本可能今年发生的购买，导致了当前的销售暴跌。 But the broader economic slowdown now appears to be taking a greater toll than the expiration of those incentives. The number of cars sold at dealerships in September was also down nearly 20 percent below the level in September 2023, before the trade-in program began. 但更广泛的经济放缓眼下所造成的影响似乎比这些激励措施的到期更大。9月经销商售出的汽车数量相比2023年9月——以旧换新计划开始之前——的水平也低了近20%。 While domestic sales have faltered, China’s car exports have soared, and are up 11-fold since 2020. The flood of Chinese-made vehicles into overseas markets has alarmed automakers elsewhere, particularly in Europe. 虽然国内销售已经动摇，中国的汽车出口却飙升，自2020年以来增长了11倍。中国制造的汽车大量涌入海外市场，令其他地方的汽车制造商感到震惊，尤其是在欧洲。 On Friday, the European Union and China said they had reached an “understanding” to limit China’s exports of plug-in hybrid cars to Europe. China’s trade surplus set another record with Europe last month. 周五，欧盟和中国表示他们已 达成“谅解” ，以限制中国向欧洲出口插电式混合动力汽车。中国上个月与欧洲的贸易顺差再创纪录。 China’s manufacturing exports have surged since it joined the World Trade Organization in 2001, when Beijing pledged to open financial services, including credit cards, to foreign competition. After 25 years of delays, during which China built its own electronic payments system, Visa announced Tuesday that Beijing took a step toward letting it establish a bank card clearing business, though further approvals are needed. 自2001年中国加入世界贸易组织以来，中国的制造业出口大幅增长，当时北京承诺向外国竞争开放金融服务，包括信用卡。在25年的拖延之后——中国利用这段时间建立了自己的电子支付系统，Visa周二宣布北京已采取措施允许其建立银行卡清算业务，但仍需进一步批准。 After decades of American complaints about delays, the Visa decision, along with the compromise with Europe on plug-in hybrid cars, suggests Beijing may be taking small steps to address foreign concerns about its trade surplus. 数十年来美国一直就这一拖延表达不满，Visa的决定以及就插电式混合动力汽车与欧洲达成的妥协表明，北京可能正在采取小步骤来解决外国对其贸易顺差的关切。 Ruoxin Zhang对本文有研究贡献。 Keith Bradsher 是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 拒绝4000万美元保密协议，她讲述马斯克的“真相”
items.description: CORALIE KRAFT2026年10月14日 Ashley St. Clair is sick of people asking her the same questions about Elon Musk. “People treat me like I’m some Elon psychoanalyst,” she said during a visit to The New York Times in September. “They want to know, ‘What’s it like to hang out with him?’ or they say, ‘Not many people have spent time with him one-on-one.’” She sighed. “It’s annoying and laborious.” 阿什莉·圣克莱尔受够了人们总是问她关于埃隆·马斯克的同样问题。“人们把我当成什么埃隆的心理分析师似的，”她在9月造访《纽约时报》时说。“他们想知道，‘和他在一起是什么感觉？’或者说，‘没有多少人和他单独相处过。’”她叹了口气。“这很烦人，也很费力。” You can’t blame them for asking. St. Clair, a former conservative influencer, gave birth to one of Musk’s children in 2024. (At the time, she also had another child from a previous relationship.) This fall, she’s a significant figure in “Musk,” Alex Gibney’s nearly four-hour-long documentary about the world’s first trillionaire, and she has more pressing points. “This is about a deeper rot in our society, where we’ve equated capital with morality,” she said. “There’s a level of societal and individual trust that we give to people if they have money.” 人们这么问也情有可原。圣克莱尔曾是保守派网红，2024年生下了马斯克的一个孩子。（当时，她还有个与前任所生的孩子。）今年秋天，在亚历克斯·吉布尼关于这位世界首位万亿富翁的近四小时纪录片《马斯克》中，她充当了重要人物，而她有更迫切需要表达的论点。“这关乎我们社会中更深层的腐烂，我们把资本等同于道德，”她说。“如果人们有钱，我们就会给予他们一定程度的社会和个人信任。” Musk did not respond to requests for comment. After TMZ reported that Ashley St. Clair rejected a $40 million N.D.A., Musk responded via X, stating, “She was never offered that and has a history of making false claims.” He also condemned Gibney’s documentary with another post on X reading, “Gibney just assembled a hit list of people who either have an axe to grind or don’t even know me.” 马斯克没有回应置评请求。在TMZ报道阿什莉·圣克莱尔拒绝了一份4000万美元的保密协议后，马斯克通过X平台回应称：“她从未收到过这样的提议，而且她有提出虚假指控的历史。”他还在X平台的另一篇帖子中谴责吉布尼的纪录片，写道：“吉布尼只是拼凑了一份名单，上面的人要么是怀有私怨，要么甚至根本不认识我。” Gibney, the Oscar-winning documentary filmmaker, first met St. Clair in December 2025. “Beyond Musk’s baby obsession, Ashley had a front-row seat during the 2024 campaign and was able to tell me things I didn’t know about Musk’s motivations,” he said in an email. Below, St. Clair shares her side of the story. 吉布尼是奥斯卡获奖纪录片导演，于2025年12月第一次见到圣克莱尔。“除了马斯克对生孩子的执念，阿什莉在2024年竞选期间身处第一线，能够向我透露许多我此前并不了解的关于马斯克动机的内幕，”他在一封电子邮件中写道。下面，圣克莱尔分享了她这一方的说法。 These are edited excerpts from the conversation. 以下是经过编辑的对话节选。 Were you at all nervous about participating in the film? 参与这部电影时你紧张吗？ No. I was familiar with some of Alex’s documentary work, like “Going Clear.” I liked that he didn’t have any fear. He has a history of treating facts and narratives with respect. 不紧张。我熟悉亚历克斯的一些纪录片作品，比如《拨开迷雾》(Going Clear)。我喜欢他的无所畏惧。他一贯尊重事实和叙事。 You’ve seen the film. How did you feel watching it? 你已经看过这部电影了。看的时候感觉如何？ What was both validating and terrifying was the way the narratives harmonized. Me, Justine [Wilson, Musk’s first wife], Sam Harris [the New Atheist philosopher] and Geoffrey Hinton [the so-called Godfather of A.I.] — there are so many similarities in our experiences with Elon. I think when you’re able to take people who have never spoken to each other and harmonize a narrative, that is the truth. 既让我感到被认可又让我感到恐惧的是，这些叙述竟然如此和谐地融合在一起。我、贾斯汀（贾斯汀·威尔逊，马斯克的第一任妻子）、萨姆·哈里斯（新无神论哲学家）和杰弗里·辛顿（所谓的人工智能教父）——我们在与埃隆的相处经历中有着太多的相似之处。我认为，如果你能让素未谋面的人在叙事上达成一致，那便是真相。 “我会说感觉在情感上很亲密。我们每天都联系，”圣克莱尔在谈到她与马斯克的关系时说道。 Elinor Kry for The New York Times What did your life look like when you met Musk in 2023? 2023年你遇见马斯克时，你的生活是什么样的？ I worked at a conservative news site, The Babylon Bee, and I was a single mom. I also had a public persona, primarily on Twitter, where I was repeating MAGA talking points. Elon followed me on Twitter and slid into my DMs. 我在保守派新闻网站《巴比伦蜜蜂》工作，是个单亲妈妈。我也有一个公众形象，主要是在Twitter上，重复“让美国再次伟大”(MAGA)的伦敦。埃隆在Twitter上关注了我，给我发了私信。 How did you feel when he followed you? 他关注你的时候，你感觉如何？ I don’t think people understand the number of eyeballs that were on everyone Elon interacted with at that time. I was getting “Congratulations!” texts from people in MAGA. Right away, there were people saying, “She’s going to be his next baby mama.” I was about to turn 24. 我觉得人们并不了解当时与埃隆互动的人都会受到多少关注。我收到MAGA人士发来的“恭喜！”短信。立刻有人说，“她要成为他下一个孩子的妈妈了。”我当时快24岁了。 And when did you meet in person for the first time? 你们第一次见面是什么时候？ We’d been DMing on Twitter, and then during an interview for the Bee, he asked, “Feel like going to Providence, R.I.?” Within an hour, I was on his plane. In Providence, we shared a hotel room, and he fell asleep listening to a podcast about Kublai Khan. It was all very surreal. 我们一直在Twitter上私信，然后在为《巴比伦蜜蜂》做采访时，他问：“想去罗德岛的普罗维登斯吗？”不到一小时，我就上了他的飞机。在普罗维登斯，我们合住一间酒店房间，他听着关于忽必烈的播客睡着了。这一切都显得非常超现实。 Did it feel like a romantic relationship? 感觉像恋爱关系吗？ I would say it felt emotionally intimate. We were in contact every day. But also I was never like, “I’m the chosen one.” At the time, he was this savior of free speech, and I was very wrapped up in all of that. I’d say there was a bit of idolization going on, too. 我会说感觉在情感上很亲密。我们每天都联系。但我也从未觉得，“我是被选中的那个。”当时，他被视为言论自由的救世主，我深深沉浸在其中。我觉得当时多少也有点把他偶像化了。 When did you start talking about having a child together? 你们什么时候开始谈论要生孩子的？ In January 2024, we went on vacation to St. Bart’s, and he said, “You should have 10 kids! Let’s have a kid. My only limited resource is time.” 2024年1月，我们去圣巴茨度假，他说：“你应该生10个孩子！我们生一个吧。我唯一有限的资源就是时间。” What did that mean to you? 这对你意味着什么？ I wanted more children, so it meant that I would always be able to take care of my kids financially. Also, within MAGA, it was seen as a stain on your character to be a single mom. So to have this bastion of the right who is very validating of that choice — that meant so much to me. 我想要更多孩子，所以这意味着我在经济上可以一直养活我的孩子们。此外，在MAGA阵营里，做单亲妈妈被视为品格上的污点。因此，能得到这位极力肯定这种选择的右翼堡垒人物的支持——这对我来说意义重大。 Did you have any hesitations? 你有过犹豫吗？ Not until I was pregnant and I watched the custody battle between Elon and Grimes [who share three children]. It made me think, “I have to protect myself.” 直到我怀孕，看到埃隆和格莱姆斯（他们共有三个孩子）的监护权争夺战，我才开始犹豫。这让我意识到，“我必须保护自己。” When did you receive the N.D.A.? 你是在什么时候收到保密协议的？ I was two months postpartum. Jared Birchall, Elon’s money manager and henchman, sent the document in a disappearing message on Signal. We didn’t have a formal financial agreement, so at that moment, getting the N.D.A. felt like, “If you would like any kind of support, sign this.” 我产后两个月。埃隆的财物经理兼得力助手贾里德·伯查尔通过Signal应用的一条阅后即焚消息发来文件。我们当时并没有签署正式的财务协议，所以在那一刻，收到保密协议的感觉就像是：“如果你想要任何形式的支持，就签了这份协议。” I see. They were saying, “If you want support, sign this.” What were the terms of the N.D.A.? 我明白了。他们是在说：“如果你想要支持，就签了这份协议。”那么保密协议的条款是什么？ I couldn’t speak about Elon or anything related to our relationship for eternity, and those terms would also apply to my heirs. I could tell our child who his father is, but I couldn’t tell my other child, or anyone else. He offered $15 million lump sum, and then $100,000 a month for 21 years. 我永远不能谈论埃隆或任何与我们关系有关的事情，这些条款也适用于我的继承人。我可以告诉我们的孩子他的父亲是谁，但我不能告诉我的另一个孩子或者任何其他人。他开出了1500万美元的一次性付款，外加21年内每月10万美元的款项。 But you decided not to sign. 但你决定不签。 For me, it was more a moral question than a legal one. I told Jared I couldn’t sign it, and he responded with, “Why? Sounds like you want to use your speech as a weapon.” I told him my children’s dignity is not a commodity. 对我来说，这更像是一个道德问题，而不是法律问题。我告诉贾里德我不能签，他回应说：“为什么？听起来你想把你的言论当作武器。”我告诉他，我孩子的尊严不是商品。 Did Musk ever talk to you about the N.D.A.? 马斯克曾和你谈过保密协议吗？ No. 没有。 And now you’re a significant voice in Gibney’s documentary. 现在你是吉布尼纪录片中的一个重要发声者。 People need to understand that part of the reason I’m featured prominently in the documentary is that other people cannot speak. I don’t think we should lose sight of that. I don’t want to have to speak publicly. I don’t want to be doing this interview right now. But there is a web of N.D.A.s. I feel a moral obligation to talk about my experience. 人们需要理解，我在纪录片中如此突出，部分原因是其他人不能发声。我认为我们不应忽视这一点。我本不想公开发声，也不想此刻接受这次采访。但有一个保密协议构成的网络。我觉得有道德义务谈论我的经历。 Let’s talk about your transition away from MAGA. When did that start? 让我们谈谈你远离MAGA的转变。那是什么时候开始的？ It happened slowly and then all at once. There were moments where I wasn’t OK with the things I was witnessing — the misogyny, the racism — but I was a coward. 这个过程先是缓慢发生，然后突然一下子就发生了。有些时刻，我对目睹的事情感到不安——厌女、种族主义——但我当时是个懦夫。 What would you say to people who think, “She’s only turning left because the right rejected her”? 对于认为“她之所以转向左翼，只是因为右翼抛弃了她”的人，你会说什么？ I’m not dumb. I was aware what would happen when I came out against Elon, and I was OK with it. There’s a video from before I was pregnant where I say I’m not a conservative. So there were already moments where you can see these breaks from the conservative establishment. 我并不傻。我知道一旦我公开反对埃隆会发生什么，我也接受。有一个我怀孕前的视频，我在里面说我不是保守派。所以其实早就有迹象表明，我与保守派主流阵营之间已经出现了裂痕。 You posted a lot of transphobic, racist and misogynistic commentary. Did other people pay the price for your public image? 你发布过很多跨性别恐惧、种族主义和厌女的评论。是否有人因你的公众形象而付出了代价？ I think about that all the time. Recently I got a notification about hospitals ending gender-affirming care. When I read that, I felt immensely remorseful. I know that probably would’ve happened without me, but I still feel guilt for my role. 我一直在想这件事。最近我收到一条通知，说有医院停止提供性别肯定治疗。读到那个时，我感到极度悔恨。我知道即使没有我，这种事也可能发生，但我仍然对自己扮演的角色感到内疚。 How do you see your role today? 你现在如何看待自己的角色？ My only job after years of propaganda and dishonesty and being involved in MAGA for almost a decade is to be honest and set an example for my kids. My job is not to set a new narrative about myself. My only job is to be held accountable. 在经历了多年宣传和不诚实、参与MAGA近十年之后，我唯一的工作就是诚实，并为我的孩子们树立榜样。我的工作不是为自己设定新的叙事。我唯一的人物就是承担责任。 Coralie Kraft是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site
items.content: CORALIE KRAFT 2026年10月14日 Ashley St. Clair is sick of people asking her the same questions about Elon Musk. “People treat me like I’m some Elon psychoanalyst,” she said during a visit to The New York Times in September. “They want to know, ‘What’s it like to hang out with him?’ or they say, ‘Not many people have spent time with him one-on-one.’” She sighed. “It’s annoying and laborious.” 阿什莉·圣克莱尔受够了人们总是问她关于埃隆·马斯克的同样问题。“人们把我当成什么埃隆的心理分析师似的，”她在9月造访《纽约时报》时说。“他们想知道，‘和他在一起是什么感觉？’或者说，‘没有多少人和他单独相处过。’”她叹了口气。“这很烦人，也很费力。” You can’t blame them for asking. St. Clair, a former conservative influencer, gave birth to one of Musk’s children in 2024. (At the time, she also had another child from a previous relationship.) This fall, she’s a significant figure in “Musk,” Alex Gibney’s nearly four-hour-long documentary about the world’s first trillionaire , and she has more pressing points. “This is about a deeper rot in our society, where we’ve equated capital with morality,” she said. “There’s a level of societal and individual trust that we give to people if they have money.” 人们这么问也情有可原。圣克莱尔曾是保守派网红，2024年生下了马斯克的一个孩子。（当时，她还有个与前任所生的孩子。）今年秋天，在亚历克斯·吉布尼关于 这位世界首位万亿富翁 的 近四小时纪录片《马斯克》 中，她充当了重要人物，而她有更迫切需要表达的论点。“这关乎我们社会中更深层的腐烂，我们把资本等同于道德，”她说。“如果人们有钱，我们就会给予他们一定程度的社会和个人信任。” Musk did not respond to requests for comment. After TMZ reported that Ashley St. Clair rejected a $40 million N.D.A., Musk responded via X , stating, “She was never offered that and has a history of making false claims.” He also condemned Gibney’s documentary with another post on X reading, “Gibney just assembled a hit list of people who either have an axe to grind or don’t even know me.” 马斯克没有回应置评请求。在TMZ报道阿什莉·圣克莱尔拒绝了一份4000万美元的保密协议后，马斯克 通过X平台回应 称：“她从未收到过这样的提议，而且她有提出虚假指控的历史。”他还在 X平台的另一篇帖子 中谴责吉布尼的纪录片，写道：“吉布尼只是拼凑了一份名单，上面的人要么是怀有私怨，要么甚至根本不认识我。” Gibney, the Oscar-winning documentary filmmaker, first met St. Clair in December 2025. “Beyond Musk’s baby obsession, Ashley had a front-row seat during the 2024 campaign and was able to tell me things I didn’t know about Musk’s motivations,” he said in an email. Below, St. Clair shares her side of the story. 吉布尼是奥斯卡获奖纪录片导演，于2025年12月第一次见到圣克莱尔。“除了马斯克对生孩子的执念，阿什莉在2024年竞选期间身处第一线，能够向我透露许多我此前并不了解的关于马斯克动机的内幕，”他在一封电子邮件中写道。下面，圣克莱尔分享了她这一方的说法。 These are edited excerpts from the conversation. 以下是经过编辑的对话节选。 Were you at all nervous about participating in the film? 参与这部电影时你紧张吗？ No. I was familiar with some of Alex’s documentary work, like “Going Clear.” I liked that he didn’t have any fear. He has a history of treating facts and narratives with respect. 不紧张。我熟悉亚历克斯的一些纪录片作品，比如《拨开迷雾》(Going Clear)。我喜欢他的无所畏惧。他一贯尊重事实和叙事。 You’ve seen the film. How did you feel watching it? 你已经看过这部电影了。看的时候感觉如何？ What was both validating and terrifying was the way the narratives harmonized. Me, Justine [Wilson, Musk’s first wife], Sam Harris [the New Atheist philosopher] and Geoffrey Hinton [the so-called Godfather of A.I.] — there are so many similarities in our experiences with Elon. I think when you’re able to take people who have never spoken to each other and harmonize a narrative, that is the truth. 既让我感到被认可又让我感到恐惧的是，这些叙述竟然如此和谐地融合在一起。我、贾斯汀（贾斯汀·威尔逊，马斯克的第一任妻子）、萨姆·哈里斯（新无神论哲学家）和杰弗里·辛顿（所谓的人工智能教父）——我们在与埃隆的相处经历中有着太多的相似之处。我认为，如果你能让素未谋面的人在叙事上达成一致，那便是真相。 “我会说感觉在情感上很亲密。我们每天都联系，”圣克莱尔在谈到她与马斯克的关系时说道。 Elinor Kry for The New York Times What did your life look like when you met Musk in 2023? 2023年你遇见马斯克时，你的生活是什么样的？ I worked at a conservative news site, The Babylon Bee, and I was a single mom. I also had a public persona, primarily on Twitter, where I was repeating MAGA talking points. Elon followed me on Twitter and slid into my DMs. 我在保守派新闻网站《巴比伦蜜蜂》工作，是个单亲妈妈。我也有一个公众形象，主要是在Twitter上，重复“让美国再次伟大”(MAGA)的伦敦。埃隆在Twitter上关注了我，给我发了私信。 How did you feel when he followed you? 他关注你的时候，你感觉如何？ I don’t think people understand the number of eyeballs that were on everyone Elon interacted with at that time. I was getting “Congratulations!” texts from people in MAGA. Right away, there were people saying, “She’s going to be his next baby mama.” I was about to turn 24. 我觉得人们并不了解当时与埃隆互动的人都会受到多少关注。我收到MAGA人士发来的“恭喜！”短信。立刻有人说，“她要成为他下一个孩子的妈妈了。”我当时快24岁了。 And when did you meet in person for the first time? 你们第一次见面是什么时候？ We’d been DMing on Twitter, and then during an interview for the Bee, he asked, “Feel like going to Providence, R.I.?” Within an hour, I was on his plane. In Providence, we shared a hotel room, and he fell asleep listening to a podcast about Kublai Khan. It was all very surreal. 我们一直在Twitter上私信，然后在为《巴比伦蜜蜂》做采访时，他问：“想去罗德岛的普罗维登斯吗？”不到一小时，我就上了他的飞机。在普罗维登斯，我们合住一间酒店房间，他听着关于忽必烈的播客睡着了。这一切都显得非常超现实。 Did it feel like a romantic relationship? 感觉像恋爱关系吗？ I would say it felt emotionally intimate. We were in contact every day. But also I was never like, “I’m the chosen one.” At the time, he was this savior of free speech, and I was very wrapped up in all of that. I’d say there was a bit of idolization going on, too. 我会说感觉在情感上很亲密。我们每天都联系。但我也从未觉得，“我是被选中的那个。”当时，他被视为言论自由的救世主，我深深沉浸在其中。我觉得当时多少也有点把他偶像化了。 When did you start talking about having a child together? 你们什么时候开始谈论要生孩子的？ In January 2024, we went on vacation to St. Bart’s, and he said, “You should have 10 kids! Let’s have a kid. My only limited resource is time.” 2024年1月，我们去圣巴茨度假，他说：“你应该生10个孩子！我们生一个吧。我唯一有限的资源就是时间。” What did that mean to you? 这对你意味着什么？ I wanted more children, so it meant that I would always be able to take care of my kids financially. Also, within MAGA, it was seen as a stain on your character to be a single mom. So to have this bastion of the right who is very validating of that choice — that meant so much to me. 我想要更多孩子，所以这意味着我在经济上可以一直养活我的孩子们。此外，在MAGA阵营里，做单亲妈妈被视为品格上的污点。因此，能得到这位极力肯定这种选择的右翼堡垒人物的支持——这对我来说意义重大。 Did you have any hesitations? 你有过犹豫吗？ Not until I was pregnant and I watched the custody battle between Elon and Grimes [who share three children]. It made me think, “I have to protect myself.” 直到我怀孕，看到 埃隆和格莱姆斯 （他们共有三个孩子）的监护权争夺战，我才开始犹豫。这让我意识到，“我必须保护自己。” When did you receive the N.D.A.? 你是在什么时候收到保密协议的？ I was two months postpartum. Jared Birchall, Elon’s money manager and henchman, sent the document in a disappearing message on Signal. We didn’t have a formal financial agreement, so at that moment, getting the N.D.A. felt like, “If you would like any kind of support, sign this.” 我产后两个月。埃隆的财物经理兼得力助手贾里德·伯查尔通过Signal应用的一条阅后即焚消息发来文件。我们当时并没有签署正式的财务协议，所以在那一刻，收到保密协议的感觉就像是：“如果你想要任何形式的支持，就签了这份协议。” I see. They were saying, “If you want support, sign this.” What were the terms of the N.D.A.? 我明白了。他们是在说：“如果你想要支持，就签了这份协议。”那么保密协议的条款是什么？ I couldn’t speak about Elon or anything related to our relationship for eternity, and those terms would also apply to my heirs. I could tell our child who his father is, but I couldn’t tell my other child, or anyone else. He offered $15 million lump sum, and then $100,000 a month for 21 years. 我永远不能谈论埃隆或任何与我们关系有关的事情，这些条款也适用于我的继承人。我可以告诉我们的孩子他的父亲是谁，但我不能告诉我的另一个孩子或者任何其他人。他开出了1500万美元的一次性付款，外加21年内每月10万美元的款项。 But you decided not to sign. 但你决定不签。 For me, it was more a moral question than a legal one. I told Jared I couldn’t sign it, and he responded with, “Why? Sounds like you want to use your speech as a weapon.” I told him my children’s dignity is not a commodity. 对我来说，这更像是一个道德问题，而不是法律问题。我告诉贾里德我不能签，他回应说：“为什么？听起来你想把你的言论当作武器。”我告诉他，我孩子的尊严不是商品。 Did Musk ever talk to you about the N.D.A.? 马斯克曾和你谈过保密协议吗？ No. 没有。 And now you’re a significant voice in Gibney’s documentary. 现在你是吉布尼纪录片中的一个重要发声者。 People need to understand that part of the reason I’m featured prominently in the documentary is that other people cannot speak. I don’t think we should lose sight of that. I don’t want to have to speak publicly. I don’t want to be doing this interview right now. But there is a web of N.D.A.s. I feel a moral obligation to talk about my experience. 人们需要理解，我在纪录片中如此突出，部分原因是其他人不能发声。我认为我们不应忽视这一点。我本不想公开发声，也不想此刻接受这次采访。但有一个保密协议构成的网络。我觉得有道德义务谈论我的经历。 Let’s talk about your transition away from MAGA. When did that start? 让我们谈谈你远离MAGA的转变。那是什么时候开始的？ It happened slowly and then all at once. There were moments where I wasn’t OK with the things I was witnessing — the misogyny, the racism — but I was a coward. 这个过程先是缓慢发生，然后突然一下子就发生了。有些时刻，我对目睹的事情感到不安——厌女、种族主义——但我当时是个懦夫。 What would you say to people who think, “She’s only turning left because the right rejected her”? 对于认为“她之所以转向左翼，只是因为右翼抛弃了她”的人，你会说什么？ I’m not dumb. I was aware what would happen when I came out against Elon, and I was OK with it. There’s a video from before I was pregnant where I say I’m not a conservative. So there were already moments where you can see these breaks from the conservative establishment. 我并不傻。我知道一旦我公开反对埃隆会发生什么，我也接受。有一个我怀孕前的视频，我在里面说我不是保守派。所以其实早就有迹象表明，我与保守派主流阵营之间已经出现了裂痕。 You posted a lot of transphobic, racist and misogynistic commentary. Did other people pay the price for your public image? 你发布过很多跨性别恐惧、种族主义和厌女的评论。是否有人因你的公众形象而付出了代价？ I think about that all the time. Recently I got a notification about hospitals ending gender-affirming care. When I read that, I felt immensely remorseful. I know that probably would’ve happened without me, but I still feel guilt for my role. 我一直在想这件事。最近我收到一条通知，说有医院停止提供性别肯定治疗。读到那个时，我感到极度悔恨。我知道即使没有我，这种事也可能发生，但我仍然对自己扮演的角色感到内疚。 How do you see your role today? 你现在如何看待自己的角色？ My only job after years of propaganda and dishonesty and being involved in MAGA for almost a decade is to be honest and set an example for my kids. My job is not to set a new narrative about myself. My only job is to be held accountable. 在经历了多年宣传和不诚实、参与MAGA近十年之后，我唯一的工作就是诚实，并为我的孩子们树立榜样。我的工作不是为自己设定新的叙事。我唯一的人物就是承担责任。 Coralie Kraft 是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人。 翻译：晋其角 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

items.title: 从特朗普“准儿媳”到被解职的美国驻希腊大使
items.description: ELISABETH BUMILLER2026年10月14日 It started out so well for her. 起初，她的一切都那么顺利。 Kimberly Guilfoyle, the U.S. ambassador to Greece until she was effectively fired on live television on Tuesday when the new White House press secretary said that President Trump had asked for her resignation, was at one point engaged to Donald Trump Jr., the president’s eldest son. The couple owned a $9.7 million home in Florida, appeared at Trump rallies together and sent each other adoring posts on Instagram. 金伯莉·吉尔福伊尔曾是美国驻希腊大使，直到周二，白宫新任新闻秘书在电视直播中宣布特朗普总统已要求她辞职，她实际上就这样被公开解职。吉尔福伊尔曾与总统的长子小唐纳德·特朗普订婚。两人在佛罗里达州拥有一栋价值970万美元的豪宅，一起出席特朗普的竞选集会，还经常在Instagram上向彼此公开示爱。 “Falling in love with my fiancé more and more every day,” Ms. Guilfoyle posted on Instagram on Valentine’s Day 2022. “@donaldjtrumpjr, you’re my best friend, my support system and my forever guy.” “我每天都比前一天更加爱我的未婚夫，”吉尔福伊尔在2022年情人节的一则Instagram帖子中写道。“@donaldjtrumpjr，你是我最好的朋友，是我的精神支柱，也是我想相伴一生的男人。” “Thanks for always being there no matter what the haters are throwing our way,” he posted in 2024. “I love you.” “谢谢你始终陪在我身边，无论那些讨厌我们的人怎样攻击我们，”小特朗普在2024年发帖写道。“我爱你。” Today, the junior Mr. Trump is married to a Florida socialite and model. And Ms. Guilfoyle, who was nominated as ambassador to Greece by the president soon after her engagement to his son was broken off two years ago, is out of a job after a series of damning reports in The Wall Street Journal, including that she asked a Republican donor to pay off $100,000 on her American Express credit card just before her Senate confirmation hearing in July 2025. 如今，小特朗普已经娶了一名来自佛罗里达州的名媛兼模特。吉尔福伊尔则在两年前与他解除婚约后不久获得特朗普总统提名，出任美国驻希腊大使，如今却丢了工作。此前，《华尔街日报》接连发表了多篇对她不利的报道，其中一篇披露，2025年7月，就在参议院举行她的大使任命确认听证会之前，她曾要求一名共和党捐款人替她偿还美国运通信用卡上的10万美元欠款。 The rise and fall of Ms. Guilfoyle, 57, was not a surprise at the White House, where many saw her as a flamboyant party girl with questionable judgment. 现年57岁的吉尔福伊尔经历了从风光无限到黯然失势的转变，在白宫，很多人对此并不意外，他们认为她是一个作风张扬、热衷派对、判断力令人质疑的女人。 Her supporters said she was in fact a substantive person underneath the glitz. Ms. Guilfoyle, a former Fox News host and a former prosecutor in San Francisco and Los Angeles, was once married to Gavin Newsom, who would go on to become governor of California and one of the Democratic Party’s most outspoken critics of Mr. Trump. 她的支持者说，在浮华外表之下，她其实是个有内涵的人。吉尔福伊尔曾是福克斯新闻主持人，也曾在旧金山和洛杉矶担任检察官，还曾与加文·纽森有过一段婚姻。纽森后来成为加利福尼亚州州长，也是民主党内最直言不讳的特朗普批评者之一。 2003年，吉尔福伊尔与当时的丈夫加文·纽森在他赢得旧金山市长选举后合影。纽森后来成为加利福尼亚州州长，也是民主党内最直言不讳的特朗普批评者之一。 Marcio Jose Sanchez/Associated Press Either way, Ms. Guilfoyle was a Trump insider with a prominent role in the family and its political operation. The president’s swiftness in firing her showed his willingness to cut off anyone who becomes a liability and an embarrassment. But it also left her with little reason to remain loyal to the president and his family at a time when Mr. Trump’s political authority is ebbing. 无论如何，吉尔福伊尔曾是特朗普圈内人，在这个家族及其政治运作中扮演着重要角色。总统如此迅速地将她解职，表明他愿意毫不犹豫地与任何成为负担、令他难堪的人切割。但与此同时，在特朗普政治权威日渐衰落之际，此举也让吉尔福伊尔几乎没有理由继续效忠总统及其家族。 In announcing her resignation, she decried what she called false accusations and said she would vigorously defend her reputation. Speaking to reporters outside the White House, Mr. Trump did little to suggest he would continue to keep her close. 在宣布辞职时，她谴责了她所称的不实指控，并表示将竭尽全力维护自己的声誉。而特朗普在白宫外对记者发表讲话时，几乎没有流露出继续与她保持亲近关系的意思。 “She wasn’t a member of my family,” he said. “She, I guess, dated my son a long time ago.” “她又不是我的家人，”他说。“我猜，她很久以前跟我儿子交往过。” Ms. Guilfoyle, who arrived in Greece less than a year ago, was a highly unusual choice for the role to begin with. 吉尔福伊尔女士不到一年前抵达希腊，而从一开始，她就不是这个职位的寻常人选。 In a sense, it was Don Jr. who got her the job, indirectly. In December 2024 he and the socialite and model, Bettina Anderson, were seen holding hands as they left a Palm Beach restaurant. The next day, President-elect Trump announced that Ms. Guilfoyle was his pick to be ambassador to Greece. 从某种意义上说，是小唐纳德间接让她得到了这份工作。2024年12月，有人看到他和社会名媛兼模特贝蒂娜·安德森手牵手离开棕榈滩一家餐厅。次日，当选总统特朗普宣布，吉尔福伊尔是他驻希腊大使的人选。 The timing suggested the president wanted her out of the country at an awkward time for Don Jr., who married Ms. Anderson this year. Ms. Guilfoyle’s allies said that was not the case, although Greeks at the time wondered if they were simply getting the woman who had been jilted by the president’s son. 这一时机表明，总统想在小唐纳德尴尬之际把她送出国外。小唐纳德今年与安德森结婚。吉尔福伊尔的盟友否认了这种说法，但当时希腊人也不禁怀疑，美国是不是只不过把一个被总统儿子抛弃的女人派给了他们。 In Athens, Ms. Guilfoyle became a sensation as soon as she arrived, on the private jet of a multimillionaire Greek American businessman. She wore a partly sheer black evening dress to a Thanksgiving week dinner, joked with the Greek president when she presented her credentials that she was working on finding a new husband and stayed out until the small hours of the morning at Athens nightclubs. 在雅典，吉尔福伊尔乘坐一位希腊裔美国亿万富翁商人的私人飞机抵达后，立刻引起轰动。感恩节那一周，她穿着一袭局部透视的黑色晚礼服出席晚宴。在递交国书时与希腊总统开玩笑说，她正在努力寻找新丈夫。她还经常流连雅典的夜总会，直到凌晨才离开。 “Oh, I wasn’t late, it was like before 3,” Ms. Guilfoyle said in an interview with The New York Times last year, referring to how she had turned up at a nightclub for the 1:30 a.m. premiere show of her friend, one of the country’s most famous pop singers, Konstantinos Argiros. “哦，不算晚，大概不到3点，”吉尔福伊尔去年接受《纽约时报》采访时说，指的是自己曾在凌晨1点半赶到一家夜总会，观看好友、希腊最著名的流行歌手之一康斯坦丁诺斯·阿尔吉罗斯的首演。 2023年，小唐纳德·特朗普与吉尔福伊尔在年度保守派政治行动会议上，当时两人已订婚。2024年底，在小特朗普被拍到与社交名媛兼模特贝蒂娜·安德森——如今是他的妻子——手牵手后不久，她被提名为驻希腊大使。 Paparazzi followed her everywhere, but Greeks at the time said Ms. Guilfoyle worked as hard as she played. By the nature of her position and what they saw as her access to the White House, they viewed her as one of the most important people in the country. Mostly forgotten were her words on Fox during the Greek financial crisis in 2015, when she called Greeks “freeloaders” who should be punished like a dog that “pees on the rug.” 狗仔队到处跟着她，但当时希腊人说，吉尔福伊尔玩得凶，工作也努力。由于她的职位性质以及他们认为她能接触白宫，他们把她视为该国最重要的人物之一。人们大多忘了她在2015年希腊金融危机期间在福克斯新闻说过的话——当时她称希腊人是“白吃白喝的人”，应该像“在地毯上撒尿”的狗一样受到惩罚。 Early on, Ms. Guilfoyle announced two important business deals, the development of a U.S.-backed port near Athens and the exploration for natural gas off the island of Corfu. Both were in the works long before she arrived in Athens, but Greek officials said she had jumped into the plans months earlier and wanted them announced on her watch. 上任不久，吉尔福伊尔便宣布了两项重要的商业协议：在雅典附近开发一个由美国支持的港口，以及在科孚岛附近勘探天然气。这两个项目早在她抵达雅典之前就已开始筹划，但希腊官员表示，她在几个月前就已参与其中，并希望在自己的任期内宣布这些项目。 Adonis Georgiadis, Greece’s health minister and a vice president of the governing conservative party, was among those impressed. “When she was first named, the people were, ‘What’s that?’” he said. But if she delivers, he said, “who cares if she has a see-through dress?” 希腊卫生部长、执政的保守党副主席阿多尼斯·乔治亚迪斯便是对她印象深刻的人士之一。“她刚获得提名时，人们都在问：‘这是什么情况？’”他说。但他表示，只要她能干出成绩，“谁还在乎她是不是穿了一件透视装？” Her downfall began last month, after The Journal reported about Ms. Guilfoyle and her potential conflicts of interest over energy deals in the Balkans. But it accelerated with the report this month that she had secretly begged a Republican donor to pay her credit card debt while she was waiting to be confirmed as ambassador. 吉尔福伊尔的失势始于上个月，当时《华尔街日报》报道了她与巴尔干地区能源交易之间可能存在的利益冲突。但真正加速她垮台的是该报本月的一篇报道，这篇报道披露，在等待大使任命获得确认期间，她曾私下恳求一名共和党捐款人替她偿还信用卡债务。 “Honey please I need you to get this done for me today,” she wrote in what appeared to be a text message to the donor, Eric Deters. Mr. Deters provided what appeared to be screenshots of their correspondence to The Times after the initial report by The Journal. “亲爱的，拜托，我需要你今天替我把这件事办妥，”她在一则似乎是发给捐款人埃里克·迪特斯的短信中写道。在《华尔街日报》最初报道后，迪特斯向《纽约时报》提供了据称是两人通信记录的截图。 It is unclear what Ms. Guilfoyle will do now. Ms. Guilfoyle denied the allegations through her lawyer at the time, and declined to comment in the Times interview last year. 该杂志报道说，这名助理获得了超过400万美元的和解金。吉尔福伊尔当时通过律师否认了这些指控，去年接受《纽约时报》采访时拒绝就此置评。 She was immensely proud of her ambassadorship. Every one until Ms. Guilfoyle was a man. 吉尔福伊尔对自己能够出任大使感到无比自豪。采访结束时，她指着大使官邸杰斐逊府入口附近的一份装裱起来的文件，上面列出了自1948年以来历任美国驻希腊大使的名字。在吉尔福伊尔之前，所有大使都是男性。 “Here I am,” she said, pointing to her name. “I almost cried.” “看，我在这里，”她指着自己的名字说。“我当时差点哭出来。” 黄安伟(Edward Wong)自雅典对本文有报道贡献。 Elisabeth Bumiller报道美国首都的民众、政治和文化，以及华盛顿做出的决定如何影响全国乃至全世界民众的生活。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

Mr. Deters provided what appeared to be screenshots of their correspondence to The Times after the initial report by The Journal. “亲爱的，拜托，我需要你今天替我把这件事办妥，”她在一则似乎是发给捐款人埃里克·迪特斯的短信中 写道 。在《华尔街日报》最初报道后，迪特斯向《纽约时报》提供了据称是两人通信记录的截图。 It is unclear what Ms. Guilfoyle will do now. Once a legal analyst for CNN and ABC in New York, her career at Fox ended in 2018, when two people familiar with her exit told The Times on the condition of anonymity that she had been forced to leave over questions about inappropriate workplace behavior. 目前尚不清楚吉尔福伊尔接下来会做什么。她曾在纽约担任美国有线电视新闻网和美国广播公司的法律分析师。2018年，她在福克斯新闻的职业生涯告终。当时，两名了解她离职内幕的人士以匿名为条件 告诉《纽约时报》 ，她因涉嫌不当职场行为被迫离开。 The New Yorker reported two years later that Ms. Guilfoyle had been forced out because of sexual harassment allegations brought by a female assistant, including that she had showed the assistant photographs of genitalia of men with whom Ms. Guilfoyle had had sexual relations. 《纽约客》两年后报道说 ，吉尔福伊尔因一名女助理提出性骚扰指控而被迫离职，其中包括她向该助理展示与她发生过性关系的男性的生殖器照片。 The magazine reported that the assistant had received a settlement of more than $4 million. Ms. Guilfoyle denied the allegations through her lawyer at the time, and declined to comment in the Times interview last year. 该杂志报道说，这名助理获得了超过400万美元的和解金。吉尔福伊尔当时通过律师否认了这些指控，去年接受《纽约时报》采访时拒绝就此置评。 She was immensely proud of her ambassadorship. At the end of the interview, she pointed out a framed document near the entrance to her official residence, Jefferson House, that listed all the American ambassadors to Greece since 1948. Every one until Ms. Guilfoyle was a man. 吉尔福伊尔对自己能够出任大使感到无比自豪。采访结束时，她指着大使官邸杰斐逊府入口附近的一份装裱起来的文件，上面列出了自1948年以来历任美国驻希腊大使的名字。在吉尔福伊尔之前，所有大使都是男性。 “Here I am,” she said, pointing to her name. “I almost cried.” “看，我在这里，”她指着自己的名字说。“我当时差点哭出来。” 黄安伟(Edward Wong)自雅典对本文有报道贡献。 Elisabeth Bumiller 报道美国首都的民众、政治和文化，以及华盛顿做出的决定如何影响全国乃至全世界民众的生活。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 比地球更适宜居住的星球？确实存在
items.description: NATALIE WOLCHOVER2026年10月14日 Merijn Hos and Jurriaan Hos A few years ago, in a lab in Berlin, the astrobiologist Iva Vilović was thrilled when she observed garden cress sprouting under a light designed to mimic a “K-dwarf” star — an orange-hued star that’s cooler and slower burning than our yellow sun. To her surprise, the cress grew even faster and taller than it did under simulated sunlight. 几年前，在柏林一间实验室里，天体生物学家伊娃·维洛维奇观察到花园水芹在模拟“K型矮星”光照的条件下发芽，兴奋不已。K型矮星是一种橙色调恒星，比我们的黄色太阳温度更低、燃烧更慢。令她意外的是，水芹的生长速度甚至比在模拟太阳光照下更快，植株也更高。 Her results suggested that photosynthesis, the process that supplies the energy for Earth’s entire food web, can happen on planets orbiting these orange stars. “K-dwarf light is a very, very interesting light source, and it should be considered, if not prioritized, for any type of search for extraterrestrial life, in my opinion,” said Dr. Vilović, now at the Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics in Potsdam, Germany. 她的结果表明，光合作用——为地球整个食物网提供能量的过程——可以在围绕这些橙色恒星运行的行星上发生。“K型矮星光是一种非常非常有趣的光源，在我看来，任何类型的外星生命搜索中都应该考虑——甚至优先考虑——这个因素，”现就职于德国波茨坦的莱布尼茨天体物理研究所的维洛维奇说。 In particular, alien life may thrive in the light of these stars on planets that are slightly larger than Earth, known as super-Earths. Scientists like Dr. Vilović believe super-Earths that orbit K-dwarfs might, in fact, be the liveliest places in the galaxy — perhaps even more suitable for life than here. 尤其值得注意的是，在这些恒星的光照下，外星生命可能在比地球稍大的行星上繁盛生长，这类行星被称为超级地球。像维洛维奇这样的科学家认为，围绕K型矮星运行的超级地球或许才是银河系中最有生机的地方，甚至可能比地球更适合生命。 Scientists call these “superhabitable worlds,” planets that would allow carbon-based life to persist longer and become even more complex and diverse than on Earth. 科学家们将这些行星称为“超级宜居世界”，即允许碳基生命比在地球上存续更久、变得更复杂和更多样的行星。 A superhabitable world — as scientists imagine it — is about 20 to 30 percent wider and twice as massive as Earth, and is placed at the right distance from its star for water to flow on its surface. The stronger gravity of this bigger Earth would hold on tighter to ambient molecules than Earth does, giving the planet a thicker atmosphere and a warmer and more stable climate, fueling the growth of extraterrestrial plants and animals (or their equivalents). The super-Earth’s bigger iron core would erect a stronger magnetic field around it, better blocking cosmic radiation. 按科学家的想象，一个超级宜居世界比地球宽约20%至30%，质量是地球的两倍，与恒星的距离恰到好处，使水能在其表面流动。这个更大的“地球”引力更强，比地球更紧地留住周围分子，赋予该行星更厚的大气层和更温暖、更稳定的气候，从而推动外星植物和动物（或它们的等同物）的生长。超级地球更大的铁核会在其周围形成更强的磁场，更好地阻挡宇宙辐射。 As for the superhabitable planet’s surface, picture paradise. An enlarged orb would be rounder and smoother than Earth, as its stronger gravity erodes continental shelves and fills in trenches. Water would spill evenly over its surface as shallow lakes and seas. 至于超级宜居行星的表面，想象一下天堂。一个更大的球体会比地球更圆、更平滑，因为其更强的引力侵蚀大陆架并填平海沟。水会以浅湖和浅海的形式均匀地漫溢在其表面。 On Earth, tropical islands and shallow seas are among the most biodiverse habitats. Now imagine a whole world of balmy archipelagos and reefs. The islands would burst with biological activity, their diverse topographies and geographic isolation fueling explosions of distinct species. Light would reach clear to the seafloor, powering abundant alien algae and plants to feed a booming marine ecosystem. 在地球上，热带岛屿和浅海是生物多样性最丰富的栖息地之一。现在想象一个遍布温暖群岛和珊瑚礁的完整世界。这些岛屿会迸发出旺盛的生物活动，其多样的地形和地理隔离推动着独特物种的爆发。光线会一直到达海底，驱动丰富的异星藻类和植物，供养一个蓬勃的海洋生态系统。 As for that light, it might be the orange glow of the planet’s K-dwarf star. 至于那光，或许就是该行星的K型矮星发出的橙色辉光。 It was in the 2010s when astronomers began contemplating planets that are a little bigger, and a little nicer, than Earth, and where to find them. The whole idea was spurred in part by a question from John Armstrong a professor at Weber State University in Utah, who asked in the comments section of an astrobiology seminar on YouTube: “Shouldn’t there be planets more habitable than Earth?” 天文学家在2010年代开始思考比地球稍大一点、稍好一点的行星，以及在哪里能找到它们。整个想法部分源于犹他州韦伯州立大学教授约翰·阿姆斯特朗的一个问题。他在YouTube上一个天体生物学研讨会的评论区问道：“难道不应该存在比地球更宜居的行星吗？” That got another astronomer, René Heller, who is now at the Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research in Germany, thinking. In the quest to discover chemical signs of life on distant worlds, he thought, astronomers have focused on finding “Earth twins,” rocky, watery, Earth-size planets orbiting sun-like stars. But when it comes to hosting life, Earth may not be the ideal archetype. After all, the fact that we’re not located at a special place in the cosmos (that we revolve around the sun, not that it revolves around us) is what the Copernican revolution was all about. 这引起了现供职于德国马克斯·普朗克太阳系研究所的天文学家勒内·海勒的思考。他认为，在寻找遥远世界生命化学迹象的过程中，天文学家一直专注于寻找“地球双胞胎”，即围绕类太阳恒星运行的岩石质、有水、地球大小的行星。但就承载生命而言，地球可能并非理想的范本。毕竟，我们并不位于宇宙中一个特殊位置（我们绕太阳转，而不是太阳绕我们转）——这正是哥白尼革命的全部意义所在。 “It occurred to me that currently, humanity is looking for Earthlike planets with the same anthropocentric bias,” Dr. Heller said. “Of course, Earth is special to us. But from a universal perspective, why should Earth be a reference?” “我想到，目前人类正以同样的人类中心主义偏见寻找类地行星，”海勒说。“当然，地球对我们来说是特殊的。但从宇宙视角来看，为什么要拿地球当参照？” In fact, Earth is only marginally habitable. Most astrobiologists think water must be present on a planet’s surface for life to arise there, and indeed the first bacteria appeared on Earth almost as soon as water pooled on its cooling surface roughly four billion years ago. But if Earth were just 2 percent closer to the sun, that pooling wouldn’t have happened. Instead, all of Earth’s water would have boiled away. We got lucky. But our luck will run out. The sun is expanding and brightening. Scientists calculate that in another half-billion years or so, Earth will be too hot to sustain complex life like plants and animals. 事实上，地球只是勉强宜居。大多数天体生物学家认为，行星表面必须有水存在才能孕育生命，而事实上，大约40亿年前水在地球冷却表面汇聚后不久，第一批细菌就出现了。但地球离太阳只需要再近2%，那种汇聚就不会发生。相反，地球所有的水都会沸腾蒸发。我们很幸运。但运气终会用完。太阳正在膨胀和变亮。科学家计算，再过大约五亿年，地球将热得无法维持植物和动物这样的复杂生命。 For Dr. Heller, the hunt for more habitable worlds is about “finding out if we are alone, if we could have been found, if there’s someone to talk to,” he said. 对海勒来说，寻找更宜居世界关乎“弄清我们是否孤独，我们是否可能被找到，有没有谁能跟我们交谈”，他说。 “Although I am not, at least in my everyday life, a very spiritual person,” he added, “it’s nevertheless something that at least drives me — this question, Could there be someone?” “尽管我——至少在日常生活中——不是一个非常注重灵性的人，”他补充道，“但这个问题仍然至少驱动着我——有没有这样的一种存在？” He contacted Dr. Armstrong, and together they wrote a 2014 paper introducing the hypothesis of superhabitable worlds, which the two envisioned as archipelago-covered super-Earths. They were proposing a new target for telescopes. 他联系了阿姆斯特朗，两人在2014年共同发表了一篇论文，提出超级宜居世界的假说，将其设想为被群岛覆盖的超级地球。当时他们是在为望远镜提出一个新目标。 “Superhabitable worlds must be considered for future follow-up observations of signs of extraterrestrial life,” they wrote. “超级宜居世界必须被考虑用于未来对外星生命迹象的后续观测，”他们写道。 In the paper, Dr. Heller and Dr. Armstrong reasoned that cool, petite K-dwarfs would be better host stars for superhabitable worlds than sun-like stars because they burn through their hydrogen fuel more slowly and brighten much more gradually. Our sun has only five billion years’ worth of hydrogen left before it will suddenly balloon and redden, becoming a red giant that will engulf the Earth. K-dwarfs, by contrast, shine steadily for tens of billions of years. This means life on a superhabitable planet orbiting a K-dwarf has far longer to evolve into ever more complex life forms. 在论文中，海勒和阿姆斯特朗论证，凉爽小巧的K型矮星比类太阳恒星更适合作为超级宜居世界的宿主恒星，因为它们燃烧氢燃料更慢，变亮的过程也更慢。我们的太阳只剩五十亿年的氢燃料，之后将突然膨胀变红，成为一颗红巨星，吞没地球。相比之下，K型矮星能稳定闪耀数百亿年。这意味着围绕K型矮星的超级宜居行星上的生命，有更多的时间来演化成渐趋复杂的生命形式。 What kinds of life forms? We can only imagine. All we know is earthlings have grown increasingly complex and sophisticated over the past four billion years, culminating so far in human-level intelligence. 什么样的生命形式？我们只能想象。我们只知道，地球居民在过去40亿年里变得越来越复杂和精密，迄今为止达到了人类级别的智能。 For Dr. Vilović, the pursuit of superhabitable planets is, in part, “an idealistic dream of a world that has beautiful conditions that are not being influenced by humans in a negative way,” she said. She thinks it’s also about a “drive to find extremes” — the most extreme version of the kind of life we know and understand. 对维洛维奇来说，追求超级宜居行星部分是“一个理想主义的梦想，关于一个拥有美丽条件、不被人类以负面方式影响的世界”，她说。她认为这还关乎“寻找极端的驱动力”——我们所知、所理解的生命类型的最极端版本。 As for whether the dream is also a reality, Dr. Vilović feels good about the odds. “I like to believe that statistically speaking, in the realm of the universe, it is likely that life exists — especially on superhabitable planets,” she said. 至于这个梦想是否也是现实，维洛维奇觉得还是有机会的。“我乐于相信，从统计上讲，在宇宙领域中，生命很可能存在——尤其是在超级宜居行星上，”她说。 翻译：经雷 点击查看本文英文版。

But from a universal perspective, why should Earth be a reference?” “我想到，目前人类正以同样的人类中心主义偏见寻找类地行星，”海勒说。“当然，地球对我们来说是特殊的。但从宇宙视角来看，为什么要拿地球当参照？” In fact, Earth is only marginally habitable. Most astrobiologists think water must be present on a planet’s surface for life to arise there, and indeed the first bacteria appeared on Earth almost as soon as water pooled on its cooling surface roughly four billion years ago. But if Earth were just 2 percent closer to the sun, that pooling wouldn’t have happened. Instead, all of Earth’s water would have boiled away. We got lucky. But our luck will run out. The sun is expanding and brightening. Scientists calculate that in another half-billion years or so, Earth will be too hot to sustain complex life like plants and animals. 事实上，地球只是勉强宜居。大多数天体生物学家认为，行星表面必须有水存在才能孕育生命，而事实上，大约40亿年前水在地球冷却表面汇聚后不久，第一批细菌就出现了。但地球离太阳只需要再近2%，那种汇聚就不会发生。相反，地球所有的水都会沸腾蒸发。我们很幸运。但运气终会用完。太阳正在膨胀和变亮。科学家计算，再过大约五亿年，地球将热得无法维持植物和动物这样的复杂生命。 For Dr. Heller, the hunt for more habitable worlds is about “finding out if we are alone, if we could have been found, if there’s someone to talk to,” he said. 对海勒来说，寻找更宜居世界关乎“弄清我们是否孤独，我们是否可能被找到，有没有谁能跟我们交谈”，他说。 “Although I am not, at least in my everyday life, a very spiritual person,” he added, “it’s nevertheless something that at least drives me — this question, Could there be someone?” “尽管我——至少在日常生活中——不是一个非常注重灵性的人，”他补充道，“但这个问题仍然至少驱动着我——有没有这样的一种存在？” He contacted Dr. Armstrong, and together they wrote a 2014 paper introducing the hypothesis of superhabitable worlds, which the two envisioned as archipelago-covered super-Earths. They were proposing a new target for telescopes. 他联系了阿姆斯特朗，两人在2014年共同发表了一篇论文，提出超级宜居世界的假说，将其设想为被群岛覆盖的超级地球。当时他们是在为望远镜提出一个新目标。 “Superhabitable worlds must be considered for future follow-up observations of signs of extraterrestrial life,” they wrote. “超级宜居世界必须被考虑用于未来对外星生命迹象的后续观测，”他们写道。 In the paper, Dr. Heller and Dr. Armstrong reasoned that cool, petite K-dwarfs would be better host stars for superhabitable worlds than sun-like stars because they burn through their hydrogen fuel more slowly and brighten much more gradually. Our sun has only five billion years’ worth of hydrogen left before it will suddenly balloon and redden, becoming a red giant that will engulf the Earth. K-dwarfs, by contrast, shine steadily for tens of billions of years. This means life on a superhabitable planet orbiting a K-dwarf has far longer to evolve into ever more complex life forms. 在论文中，海勒和阿姆斯特朗论证，凉爽小巧的K型矮星比类太阳恒星更适合作为超级宜居世界的宿主恒星，因为它们燃烧氢燃料更慢，变亮的过程也更慢。我们的太阳只剩五十亿年的氢燃料，之后将突然膨胀变红，成为一颗红巨星，吞没地球。相比之下，K型矮星能稳定闪耀数百亿年。这意味着围绕K型矮星的超级宜居行星上的生命，有更多的时间来演化成渐趋复杂的生命形式。 What kinds of life forms? We can only imagine. All we know is earthlings have grown increasingly complex and sophisticated over the past four billion years, culminating so far in human-level intelligence. 什么样的生命形式？我们只能想象。我们只知道，地球居民在过去40亿年里变得越来越复杂和精密，迄今为止达到了人类级别的智能。 For Dr. Vilović, the pursuit of superhabitable planets is, in part, “an idealistic dream of a world that has beautiful conditions that are not being influenced by humans in a negative way,” she said. She thinks it’s also about a “drive to find extremes” — the most extreme version of the kind of life we know and understand. 对维洛维奇来说，追求超级宜居行星部分是“一个理想主义的梦想，关于一个拥有美丽条件、不被人类以负面方式影响的世界”，她说。她认为这还关乎“寻找极端的驱动力”——我们所知、所理解的生命类型的最极端版本。 As for whether the dream is also a reality, Dr. Vilović feels good about the odds. “I like to believe that statistically speaking, in the realm of the universe, it is likely that life exists — especially on superhabitable planets,” she said. 至于这个梦想是否也是现实，维洛维奇觉得还是有机会的。“我乐于相信，从统计上讲，在宇宙领域中，生命很可能存在——尤其是在超级宜居行星上，”她说。 翻译：经雷 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: morluto/rea
items.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries. https://rea.tools English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Türkçe · Русский · Tiếng Việt · ไทย · Deutsch · Español · Français · Українська · Polski · Português (Brasil) · العربية · فارسی · Bahasa Indonesia · Italiano · Ελληνικά REA: Reverse Engineer Anything One MCP for reverse engineering across binaries, applications, and runtime behavior. See a feature you like. Understand how it works, down to the binary level. Website · Guides · Showcases Quick start · How REA works · What you can analyze · Showcases · FAQ · Documentation npx rea-agents setup Important Get REA from morluto/rea, rea.tools, or the rea-agents npm package. Follow the installation and release links from these official sources. A similar repository name or copied README does not establish that a download is official. Join the Reverse Engineering Community Discord · Q&A · Show and Tell See a feature in an app that you want in your own product? Ask your agent to investigate it with REA. It can inspect the app without its source code, explain how the feature works, show the evidence, and build a version for your project. REA connects your agent to tools for inspecting native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. You can also use the same tools from your terminal. Analysis runs locally, and results include the evidence and limitations behind each conclusion. Setup registers REA with your agent and installs matching workflow instructions. Native analysis can use an existing Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA installation; setup can optionally install Hopper with approval. Static JavaScript analysis needs no native analysis engine. Visit the REA website for setup instructions, illustrated guides, and real case studies. Quick start On Linux, Ghidra, JADX, firmware tool launches and static JavaScript/Electron analysis require a procps-compatible ps on REA's PATH for process ownership checks. Recovery steps are in docs/installation.md under "Linux owned-process prerequisite". Set up your agent With Node.js and npm installed, run: npx rea-agents setup Choose your agents, review the proposed changes, and approve them. Setup adds REA's MCP server and matching workflow instructions, with backups of existing configuration. Restart your agent afterward. Setup supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build and other agents. See installation and setup for provider configuration and manual MCP registration. Ask your agent Understand how search works in the Notes app, show me the evidence, and build a similar feature for my project. Replace Notes with your target app and the feature you want to understand. Use the terminal Inspect an extracted JavaScript/Electron app directory or ASAR: npx -y rea-agents@latest analyze-javascript-application /absolute/path/to/app --json The result includes modules, imports, Electron boundaries and their evidence. Replace the path with your target, such as "D:/apps/example" on Windows. To install the rea command for regular use: npm install --global rea-agents rea --help For native analysis, configure a provider first. See the CLI and Evidence guide for native commands, provider selection, snapshots and scripting. Update REA REA changes quickly, and new releases include frequent bug fixes. Keep your installation up to date. For a CLI installed with npm install --global or bun add --global: rea update Bun global updates require Bun 1.2.17 or later. With an older Bun release, upgrade Bun manually before running rea update. To refresh your agent registrations and skill, run the setup command printed by the update. If you use npx, update your agent setup with: npx rea-agents@latest setup Review the setup changes and restart your agent. For one-off CLI commands, use npx rea-agents@latest followed by the command. With Bun, use bunx rea-agents@latest in place of npx rea-agents@latest. How REA works Your agent calls REA through MCP to inspect the target and trace relevant code. REA returns findings with their evidence. The agent uses them to ask follow-up questions, explain the behavior, or write and test an implementation. CLI commands use the same workflows. Open the full-size figure. What you can analyze REA requires Node.js 22.x (>=22.19), 24.x (>=24.11), or 26+, plus npm. Additional tools and host support depend on the target: Target What REA returns Requirements and guide Native binaries Pseudocode, assembly, strings, symbols, calls and references Hopper, Ghidra or IDA; native analysis Offline ELF layout Sections, segments, original symbols/relocations and static mitigation candidates Caller-supplied pwntools on Linux x64; binary diagnostics Go binaries Embedded compiler version, modules, replacements and build settings Built-in static ELF/PE/thin Mach-O inspection; no Go installation required Rust binaries Embedded cargo-auditable crate names, versions, sources and dependency edges Built-in static ELF/PE/thin Mach-O inspection; Rust binaries WASM artifact Validation, sections, exact import/export WAT forms and decoded WAT Caller-supplied WABT 1.0.42; inspect_wasm_artifact EVM bytecode Dispatch selectors, byte offsets, inferred arguments and mutability Local raw/hex carrier on Linux x64; offline EVM guide SQLite databases Tables, columns, indexes, views, triggers and selected ordinary-table rows Local database/WAL snapshot; Node.js 24.x >=24.15 or 26+ with native SQLite limits Recorded Linux crashes Raw notes, every recorded thread's registers/signals and optional mapping candidates Caller-supplied pwntools on Linux x64; optional GDB/pwndbg; recorded crashes JavaScript / Electron Modules, imports, source maps, routes, IPC and native add-on relationships Node.js and npm; Linux: procps-compatible ps; application analysis Websites Page structure, scripts, network observations and requested screenshots A Chrome-family browser; browser analysis Saved network captures Requests, responses, exposed payloads and source locations HAR or Fiddler Everywhere SAZ; mitmdump on Linux for native mitmproxy; capture guide .NET assemblies Metadata, CIL instructions, declared native dependencies and build comparisons None (static only); managed-code guide Android APKs Manifest declarations, classes, decompiled methods and references Headless JADX and a full JDK on Linux/macOS/Windows x64; Android guide Android devices Devices, packages, processes, logs, dumps, screen captures, and APK/file transfers Caller-supplied adb (emulator or hardware); ADB guide JEB projects Engine-backed project units, artifact digests and type/method pseudo-code A caller-started JEB client serving MCP, selected with REA_JEB_MCP_URL; JEB guide Android resources Decoded manifest, string tables, locales and version facts Caller-supplied Apktool launcher; resource guide Flutter apps Dart snapshot hash, per-ABI library digests and engine build provenance None (static APK parsing); Flutter guide Firmware Regions, extraction results and native-analysis handoffs Binwalk / Unblob on Linux; firmware guide Recorded packets Selected fields, repeated values, filters and decode-as rules Linux: TShark 4.x + prlimit; capture guide Packet summaries Endpoints, DNS, TLS SNI, protocol distribution and HTTP requests Caller-supplied tshark and capinfos (Linux-verified); pcap guide Recorded logic signals Decoder annotations, sample ranges and diagnostics Linux: sigrok-cli 0.7.2 + prlimit; signal recordings Packages and resources File inventories, digests, plists, Apple bundle anatomy and extracted resources Artifact and JavaScript guide, Apple applications Process behavior Terminal output, interactions, exit and filesystem observations, and run comparisons Linux/macOS with a native PTY; process capture Static JavaScript and .NET inspection read the supplied files without running the application. Runtime capture runs or interacts with the selected target using your user permissions; each runtime guide describes its effects. For offline native-binary inspection, REA also supports caller-supplied GNU objdump and Rizin. See the reverse-engineering tools guide for provider setup, CLI commands, and Evidence limitations. REA does not install or update either provider. Native formats and host support vary by provider. See Hopper and Ghidra setup, the IDA guide (including an optional native MCP bridge), and experimental Windows Ghidra support. Ghidra also supports 16-bit DOS analysis. For large binaries, raise the provider's startup deadline with REA_GHIDRA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS or REA_HOPPER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS. For provider selection, see the CLI guide. Check release availability for features added since the latest npm release. Showcases DX-Ball: reconstruct a sound-pan calculation Follow a sound call into its position-to-pan helper, inspect the instructions, and turn incomplete pseudocode into C. The reconstruction passes 3,205 original-x86 cases and reproduces all 63 compiled function bytes. Read the case study · Reconstruction repository Notion: trace the Electron clipboard bridge Find the renderer's clipboard API, follow it through preload and IPC into the main process, and inspect the rich clipboard format. Read the case study TH04: recover a DOS bullet-ring calculation Inspect the original PC-98 game's 16-bit instructions, recover the fixed and aimed angle calculations, and compare the reconstructed C++ with the historical compiler output. Read the case study · Reconstruction repository If you've used REA on something interesting, we'd love to see it. Share your case in an issue or a pull request, including the target, your question, how REA helped, and what you found. FAQ Which agents can use REA? Any agent that supports local MCP servers. Setup configures the supported agents; other clients can use manual MCP registration. Do I need Hopper, Ghidra or IDA? Deep native analysis uses one of them. Static JavaScript and .NET inspection work without a native analysis engine. Setup can install Hopper after approval; Ghidra and IDA use your existing installations. See provider setup. Do I need to start Hopper first? REA starts Hopper when an operation needs it. On macOS, a first-run dialog may ask you to choose demo mode or activate your license. Complete that prompt in the same user session before your first CLI/MCP operation or unattended job. Open Hopper manually if needed. See Hopper startup and troubleshooting. What does installing the skill from skills.sh do? The skill supplies investigation instructions for your agent. Use npx rea-agents setup to register REA's MCP server and install the matching instructions, then restart your agent. See skill-only installation. What code does REA return? Native analysis returns pseudocode and assembly. JavaScript/Electron analysis recovers modules and their relationships. Your agent uses these findings to write and test an implementation; the showcases give worked examples. Does REA upload my app? REA analyzes targets locally. Your agent receives the tool results, and its model provider has its own data policy. What should I do if I hit a bug? Update first; a recent release may already fix it. For a CLI installed with npm install --global or bun add --global: rea update For agent setup through npx: npx rea-agents@latest setup If you're using an agent, complete the setup refresh and restart it. Retry the same task. If the problem persists, open an issue with your REA version, target type, steps to reproduce and error output. Documentation Start with the website's worked guides. For exact options, prerequisites and result contracts: Installation and setup: agent registration, provider configuration, updates and uninstall. Readiness and troubleshooting: diagnose one agent or analysis engine. CLI and Evidence: commands, provider selection, snapshots, import/export and exit statuses. MCP contracts and agent prompts: tool results, sessions and guided investigations. Tool catalog: generated inventory of tools, providers and CLI commands. Roadmap: planned work and capability trackers. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md. Star history 🎉 200,000 GitHub stars — thank you! Thanks to everyone using REA, reporting bugs, requesting features, testing builds, and contributing fixes. Disclaimer See DISCLAIMER.md for responsible-use guidance. The project's position on illegal or unauthorized use covers all REA versions, distribution channels, and platforms; each copy retains its applicable licenses. REA is for lawful research, education, interoperability, software preservation, and analysis of software you own or are authorized to examine. Contributing We'd love your help with REA! Open an issue to report a bug or suggest a feature, or send a pull request to improve the code or docs. See CONTRIBUTING.md for development setup and checks, testing for verification lanes, and the architecture map for the project structure. License MIT REA-authored code is licensed under MIT. Third-party material retains its own licenses and copyright notices; see Third-party notices for the dependency inventory, preserved license texts, and external-tool terms. You must legally obtain and be authorized to use commercial tools, including IDA Pro / Hex-Rays decompilers, Hopper, and JEB, under their applicable licenses. REA grants no tool license, key, or activation entitlement. Trials and demos remain subject to vendor terms, including user, feature, automation, and output sharing restrictions. Cracked copies, stolen keys, unauthorized key sharing, and bypassing license restrictions are not authorized. This guidance does not amend MIT or third-party licenses.

items.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages. https://voicestudio.sh VoiceStudio Open-source voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages. Website · Download · Get started · Docs · Discord · 简体中文 · 日本語 Your voice. Your workflow. Create Produce Connect Clone a voice or design your own Dub videos with timed speech Local API & MCP for agents Dictate with a floating widget Stories, audiobooks & batch jobs Reusable recipes & watch folders Start with VoiceStudio (default, powered by k2-fsa/OmniVoice), or choose another engine. Features & engine catalog. Local workflows run on your hardware. Remote services are optional; usage analytics requires consent. Explore the workspaces · Clone, dub, design & models Voice cloning Video dubbing Voice design Local models Get started One-command install (macOS / Linux) # Latest Electron release curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh # A specific published Electron release (replace X.Y.Z) curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --version X.Y.Z # Build current main and install the desktop app curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --main # Uninstall the app, keeping your data curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --uninstall On Windows, run irm https://voicestudio.sh/install | iex in PowerShell. Release downloads require curl and a SHA-256 tool. --main requires Git, Node.js 22+, Bun, Rust/Cargo, and platform build tools; see installer prerequisites and behavior. The installer preserves your settings, projects, and models. Older versions must contain Electron packages; it never falls back to archived Tauri builds. Or download from Releases (macOS .dmg, Windows .exe, Linux .AppImage or .deb) and follow your platform guide: macOS · Windows · Linux · Docker Hardware Support NVIDIA GPU (Windows / Linux) CUDA acceleration Apple Silicon Metal (MPS) acceleration No dedicated GPU (Intel/AMD integrated graphics, older PCs) Fully usable on the CPU, slower; setup installs the small CPU build of PyTorch (about 5 GB free disk) Windows on ARM (Snapdragon X etc.) Experimental, validation pending: native ARM64 app, x64 Python backend under emulation, CPU only Intel Mac App UI only; connect to a remote backend (why) Open Voice cloning, choose a voice or add a clean reference recording, enter your text, and generate. Install the required model when prompted. Hardware needs vary by engine; see performance. Install with prompt Paste into your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …): Install the VoiceStudio Electron app on this device and verify it works, following https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/main/docs/install/agent.md The agent guide covers hardware detection, reusing existing data, asking before model downloads, and a test generation. Agents that support skills can also run npx skills add debpalash/VoiceStudio. Run the Electron preview from source git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git cd VoiceStudio bun install bun run setup:api # prepare Python dependencies before starting Electron bun run dev See Electron setup for prerequisites and backend configuration. Use bun run smoke-test to build and launch an isolated packaged Electron app. Add -- --install for the networked managed-runtime installation check. Electron is the only desktop app and web UI. Version 0.5.3 was the final Tauri release. Existing Tauri users must install Electron separately. The retired Tauri shell and legacy UI entry points have been removed. Documentation Need Start here Setup help Troubleshooting · Model downloads Models & audio quality Engine guides · Benchmarks Integrations Local API · MCP · Examples Development Contributing · Electron · Changelog Agent skills: npx skills add debpalash/VoiceStudio — choose voicestudio for audio workflows or voicestudio-maintainer for repository maintenance. Sponsors Become a featured partner. Apply for a paid placement · Email us Support development: Ko-fi · PayPal · Sponsorship details License & responsible use AGPL-3.0 covers the application, including commercial use under its conditions. Model weights, tokenizers, voices and generated-output conditions are separate; a paid app licence does not grant those rights. Clone voices only with permission. Model Manager now shows versioned model-source notices, evidence links and unresolved review gaps from the shared inventory. Its optional reviewed-file preview does not enforce ordinary downloads or certify commercial permission. See license details.
